Naye mu kuyiga kuno, tukyusa ebirowoozo byaffe ku ludda lumu olw’okusaba — olw’okwetayirira; okunyigiriza Katonda n’okwegomba kwaffe, n’amaanyi era n’obugumiikiriza; okusaba n’obunywevu n’obunyiikivu obutaddirira era obutakoma okutuusa okwegayirira kwakwo lwe kuwulirwa, n’ensonga yaakwo n’ewangulwa. Oyo alina okumanya okutangaavu ku Katonda, n’endowooza ku mpisa za Katonda eziva mu Bayibuli; asiima enkizo ye ey’okusemberera Katonda; ategeera nti munda mu ye yeetaaga byonna Katonda by’amuterekedde — omuntu oyo ajja kuba ayaayaana, ayogera lwatu, era eyeetayirira. Mu Kigambo Ekitukuvu, omulimu gw’okusaba gwennyini gukubirizibwa mu bigambo ebisinga katono amaanyi ku ebyo ebyogera ku bwetaavu bw’okwetayirira mu kwo. Okusaba okukyusa Katonda kwogerwako nga kwe kufuka omutima okw’omuntu omutuukirivu okw’omwoyo ogwaka era okulina amaanyi. Kwe kugamba nti, kwe kusaba okuliko omuliro, ogutali gwa kalimi kanafu akakankana, si kumyansa kwa kaseera katono, wabula ogwaka n’ekitangaala eky’amaanyi era ekinywevu. Okwegayirira kwa Ibulayimu okw’emirundi n’emirundi olw’okulokolebwa kwa Sodomu ne Ggomola kwe kulabirako okw’edda okulaga obwetaavu, n’omugaso oguva mu kusaba okw’okwetayirira. Yakobo, eyameggana ne malayika ekiro kyonna, alaga mu ngeri ey’amaanyi obuyinza bw’okunyiikira okutaddirira mu kusaba, era alaga nga mu bintu eby’omwoyo okwetayirira bwe kuwangula, nga bwe kuwangula mu bintu eby’ensi n’ebyo ebirabika. Nga bwe twalaba awalala, Musa yasaba ennaku amakumi ana emisana n’ekiro, ng’agezaako okuziyiza obusungu bwa Katonda eri Isirayiri, era ekyokulabirako kye n’obuwanguzi bwe bizzaamu amaanyi okukkiriza kw’ennaku zino mu kiseera kyakwo ekisinga ekizikiza. Eriya yaddiŋŋana okusaba kwe era n’akunyiikiramu emirundi musanvu ekire ky’enkuba nga tekinnalabika ku ggulu, nga kirangirira obuwanguzi bw’okusaba kwe n’okuwangula kw’okukkiriza kwe. Ku mulundi gumu Danyeri, newaakubadde nga yali ayongobedde era munafu, yanyiikira mu nsonga ye okumala wiiki ssatu, okuddibwamu n’omukisa nga tebinnajja. Ebiro bingi mu bulamu bwe ku nsi Omulokozi waffe ow’omukisa yabimala mu kusaba. Mu Gesusemane yaleeta okwegayirira kumu emirundi esatu, n’okwetayirira okutakendeera, okw’amaanyi, naye okw’obuwulize, okwazingiramu buli kitundu ky’emmeeme ye, ne kuvaamu amaziga n’entuuyo ez’omusaayi. Ebiseera ebikulu mu bulamu bwe byalabikira ddala, n’obuwanguzi bwe bwonna bwawangulirwa, mu biseera eby’okusaba okw’okwetayirira. Era Omuddu tasinga mukama we. Olugero lwa Nnamwandu Eyeetayirira lwe lugero olusingayo ku kusaba okutalekulira. Kijja kutugasa okujjukira olugero olwo, mu kifo kino eky’okuyiga kwaffe: "Awo Yesu n’agerera abayigirizwa be olugero ng’agamba nga bwe bagwanidde obutakoowanga kusaba n’obutaggwaamu mwoyo, Waaliwo omulamuzi mu kibuga ekimu, nga tatya Katonda era nga tafa ku muntu yenna. Mu kibuga ekyo mwalimu nnamwandu eyajjanga ew’omulamuzi oyo buli lunaku ng’amwegayirira nti, Nnamula n’omulabe wange. Omulamuzi n’amala ebbanga ng’akyagaanyi. Naye oluvannyuma n’agamba mu mutima gwe nti, Newaakubadde nga sitya Katonda era nga sirina muntu gwe nzisaamu kitiibwa, naye olwokubanga nnamwandu ono aneetayiridde nnyo, nzijja kumumalira ensonga ze, kubanga ajja kunkooya olw’okuneetayirira ng’ajja gye ndi buli lunaku! Awo Mukama waffe n’agamba nti, Muwulire omulamuzi atali wa mazima bw’agamba. Kale Katonda talisingawo nnyo kulamula abantu be, be yeerondera, abamukaabirira emisana n’ekiro ate ng’abagumiikiriza? Mbagamba nti agenda kubalamula mangu." Olugero luno lunyweza amazima ag’omusingi ag’okusaba okw’okwetayirira. Nnamwandu anyigiriza ensonga ye okutuusa omulamuzi atali wa mazima lw’agonda. Olugero luno bwe luba nga teluyigiriza bwetaavu bw’okwetayirira, terulina makulu wadde okuyigiriza kwonna. Ggyamu endowooza eno emu, toosigaze kintu kyonna ekisaana okuwandiikibwa. Awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna, Kristo yagenderera lubeere obujulizi bw’obwetaavu obuliwo, obw’okusaba okutalekulira. Okuyigiriza kwe kumu kunywezebwa mu ebyo ebyatuuka ku mukazi Omusulofoyiniiki, eyajja eri Yesu ku lwa muwala we. Wano, okwetayirira kulagibwa, si ng’obuyisi obw’obujoozi, wabula ng’okwambadde ebyambalo ebisikiriza eby’obwetoowaze, obwesimbu, n’omwoyo ogwaka. Tulagibwa akatundu ku kukkiriza okunywerera okw’omukazi, ennaku ey’obulumi ey’omukazi, n’okutegeera okw’omwoyo okw’omukazi. Omusomesa yasomoka n’agenda mu nsi eyo ey’e Sidoni amazima gano galyoke galabikire emirembe gyonna — tewali kwegayirira kukola nnyo ng’okusaba okw’okwetayirira, era tewali kwe Katonda yeewaayo nnyo era mu ddembe bw’atyo. Okwetayirira kwa maama ono eyali mu buyinike kwamuwangulira, era ne kufuula okusaba kwe ekintu ekituukiridde. Naye mu kifo ky’okunyiiza Omulokozi, kwamuleetera okwogera ekigambo eky’okwewuunya, n’essanyu eritasuubirwa. "Mukazi watu, ng’okukkiriza kwo kunene! Kale kikukolerwe nga bw’oyagala." Oyo atanyigiriza kwegayirira kwe tasaba n’akatono. Okusaba okunnyogovu tekulina kye kusaba mu ggulu, era tekuwulirwa mu mpya za waggulu. Omuliro bwe bulamu bw’okusaba, era eggulu lituukibwako olw’okwetayirira okwaka ng’omuliro, nga kulinnya waggulu buli kiseera. Bwe tuddayo ku nsonga ya nnamwandu eyeetayirira, tulaba nti obwannamwandu bwe, obutaba na mukwano, n’obunafu bwe tebyalina kye bitegeeza eri omulamuzi atali wa mazima. Okwetayirira kwe kwali buli kimu. "olwokubanga nnamwandu ono aneetayiridde nnyo," bwe yagamba, "nzijja kumumalira ensonga ze" — era mangu — "kubanga nnamwandu ono aneetayiridde nnyo, nzijja kumumalira ensonga ze, kubanga ajja kunkooya." Olw’ensonga eno yokka nti nnamwandu yamutwalira obudde n’amaaso g’omulamuzi atali wa mazima, ensonga ye n’ewangulwa. Katonda alindirira n’obugumiikiriza, ng’emisana n’ekiro abalonde be bwe bamukaabirira. Okwegayirira kwabwe kumukwatako emirundi lukumi okusinga bwe kwakwata ku mulamuzi oyo atali wa mazima. Okulwa kwe kuteekebwako ekkomo olw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira okw’abantu be, era okuddibwamu kuweebwa mu bungi. Katonda asanga okukkiriza mu mwana we asaba — okukkiriza okunywerera era okukaaba — n’akuwa ekitiibwa ng’akukkiriza okweyongera okukozesebwa, kulyoke kunywezebwe era kugaggawale. Olwo n’akusasula ng’akuwa ekyo kye kwegayirira kye kwali kusinga okwetikka, mu bujjuvu era mu ngeri ey’enkomerero. Ensonga y’omukazi Omusulofoyiniiki gye twayogeddeko waggulu kye kyokulabirako ekyeyoleka eky’okwetayirira okwawangula, ekizzaamu nnyo amaanyi abo bonna abaagala okusaba nga bawangula. Kyali kyokulabirako kya kitalo eky’okunywerera n’okugumiikiriza okutuuka ku buwanguzi obw’enkomerero, mu maaso g’ebiziyiza n’ebizibu kumpi ebitayinza kuwangulwa. Naye omukazi yabiwangula byonna olw’okukkiriza okw’obuzira n’omwoyo ogunyiikira, ebyali eby’ekitalo nga bwe byawangula. Yesu yali agenze mu nsi ye, "n’atayagala kitegeerekeke nti ali mu bitundu ebyo." Naye omukazi amenya ekigendererwa kye, ayingirira ekyama kye, asikiriza amaaso ge, era amufukira okwegayirira okulumya okw’obwetaavu n’okukkiriza. Omutima gwe gwali mu kusaba kwe. Mu kusooka, Yesu alabika ng’atafaayo ku bulumi bwe, era tafaayo ku kukaaba kwe ng’asaba okuyambibwa. Tamuwa liiso, wadde okutu, wadde ekigambo. Okusirika, okw’amaanyi era okunyogovu, kwe kwaniriza okukaaba kwe okw’omutima ogwaka. Naye takyuka, era taggwaamu maanyi. Anywerera. Abayigirizwa, nga banyiigidde oluyoogaano lwe olutasaana, bamwegayiririra, naye ne basirisibwa Mukama waffe bw’alangirira nti omukazi ali bweru ddala w’ekigendererwa kye n’obuweereza bwe. Naye okulemererwa kw’abayigirizwa okumufunira okuwulirwa, wadde okumanya — okw’okuggwaamu essuubi mu buzaaliranwa bwakwo — nti aziyizibwa emikisa gy’omulimu gwe, tebyamutiisa, era byamwongera bwongezi amaanyi n’obuvumu bw’okusemberera Kristo. Yasembera kumpi, n’asala okusaba kwe wakati, n’agwa ku bigere bye, ng’amusinza, era ng’ensonga ya muwala we agifuula okukaaba kwe ye, mu bigambo ebimpi era ebyoogi — "Mukama wange, nnyamba." Okukaaba kuno okw’enkomerero kwe kwamuwangulira ensonga ye; muwala we n’awonyezebwa mu kiseera ekyo kyennyini. Ng’alina essuubi, ng’anyiikira, era nga takoowa, abeera kumpi n’Omusomesa, ng’anywerera era ng’asaba okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kuweebwa. Nga kino kyokuyiga kya kitalo ku kwetayirira, ku bumalirivu, ku kunyiikira, ebyakubirizibwa era ne bisindiikirizibwa mu mbeera ezandiggyeemu amaanyi buli muntu yenna okuggyako emmeeme ey’obuzira era enywevu. Mu ngero zino ez’okusaba okw’okwetayirira, Mukama waffe atulaga, olw’okutumanyisa n’okutuzzaamu amaanyi, ebizibu eby’amaanyi ebiyimirira mu kkubo ly’okusaba. Mu kiseera kye kimu ayigiriza nti okwetayirira kuwangula embeera zonna embi era kwefunira obuwanguzi ku kibinja kyonna eky’ebiziyiza. Ate era ayigiriza nti okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwesigamye ku bungi bw’okukkiriza okuteekebwa mu kwegayirira. Okukugezesa, alwisaawo okuddamu. Omusabi ow’okungulu asirika, okuddibwamu bwe kulwawo. Naye omuntu ow’okusaba anywerera, era yeeyongera okunywerera. Mukama ategeera okukkiriza kwe era akuwa ekitiibwa, era amuddamu mu ngeri ey’omugaso era mu bungi ku kusaba kwe okw’okwetayirira okulaga okukkiriza kwe.

fields.title: Okusaba n’Okwetayirira (Kweyongerayo)
fields.body_html:
"Ebitundu bibiri ku bisatu eby’okusaba kwe tukola, kuba kwa bintu ebyandituleetedde essanyu erisingayo bwe twandibifunye. Kika kya kwesanyusa mu by’omwoyo kye twenyigiramu, era olw’ekyo kye kifaananyi ekikontana ddala n’okwefuga. Katonda ekyo kyonna akimanyi, era akuuma abaana be nga basaba. Ekiseera bwe kiyitawo — mu kiseera kye — okwegayirira kwaffe kufuna endabika endala, naffe ne tufuna engeri endala ey’okusemberera mu by’omwoyo. Katonda atukuuma nga tusaba okutuusa, mu magezi ge, lw’asiima okuddamu. Era ne bwe kiba kimala bbanga ddene litya nga tannayogera, n’olwo kiba kya mangu nnyo okusinga bwe tulina eddembe okusuubira oba okusuubira okusaanira." — ATAMANYIKIDDWA.

EKIGENDERERWA ky’enjigiriza za Kristo kwe kulangirira nti abantu basaanidde okusaba n’amaanyi — okusaba n’obumalirivu obutayinza kugaanibwa. Eggulu lirina amatu agawuliriza abo bokka abalina omutima gwonna, n’abamalirivu ennyo. Amaanyi, obuvumu, n’okunyiikira okutaddirira birina okuwagira okusaba eggulu kwe lissaamu ekitiibwa, era Katonda kw’awulira. Empisa zino zonna ez’emmeeme, ezeetaagisa ennyo mu kusaba okulina amaanyi, zirabikira mu lugero lw’omusajja eyagenda ewa mukwano gwe okusaba emigaati, mu ttumbi. Omusajja ono yagenda ku mulimu gwe ng’alina obwesige. Omukwano gwamusuubiza okutuuka ku buwanguzi. Okwegayirira kwe kwali kwa bwangu: mazima, teyayinza kuddayo ngalo nsa. Okugaanibwa okw’olwatu kwamunakuwaza era ne kumwewuunyisa. Wano n’omukwano gwalemererwa! Naye waaliwo ekintu ekyali kikyasigadde okugezaako — okumalirira okw’amaanyi, okumalirira okunywevu era okutakyukakyuka. Yali wa kusigala n’anyigiriza okusaba kwe okutuusa oluggi lwe lwandiggulwawo, n’okusaba kwe ne kukkirizibwa. Kino kye yakola, era olw’amaanyi g’okwetayirira n’afuna ekyo okusaba okwa bulijjo kye kwali kulemereddwa okufuna.

Obuwanguzi bw’omusajja ono, obwafunibwa mu maaso g’okugaanibwa okw’olwatu, Omulokozi yabukozesa okulaga obwetaavu bw’okunywerera mu kwegayirira ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Okuddibwamu bwe kutaweebwa mangu ago, Omukristaayo asaba alina okukuŋŋaanya obuvumu buli lwe kulwawo, era yeeyongere okunyiikira okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja, okukakasiddwa, singa abeera n’okukkiriza okunyigiriza okwegayirira kwe n’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi.

Obugayaavu, okuggwaamu omwoyo, obutagumiikiriza, n’okutya bijja kuzikiriza okusaba kwaffe. Ekirindirira okulumba kw’okwetayirira kwaffe n’okunywerera kwaffe gwe mutima gwa Kitaffe, omukono gwa Kitaffe, amaanyi ga Kitaffe agatakoma, n’okwagala kwa Kitaffe okutakoma okuwulira n’okuwa abaana be.

Okusaba okw’okwetayirira kwe kutambula okw’amaanyi okw’omunda okw’omutima okugenda eri Katonda. Kwe kussa amaanyi gonna ag’omuntu ow’omwoyo mu kusaba. Isaaya yakungubaga nti tewali n’omu eyewalirizanga okukwata ku Katonda. Okusaba kungi kwakolebwanga mu biseera bya Isaaya, naye kwali kwangu nnyo, kwa bugayaavu era kwa kwematira. Tewaaliwo kutambula kwa maanyi okw’emmeeme okugenda eri Katonda. Tewaaliwo maanyi matukuvu agasimbye ennyiriri nga gamaliridde okutuuka ku Katonda n’okumeggana naye, okuggya gy’ali eby’obugagga eby’ekisa kye. Okusaba okutaliimu maanyi tekulina buyinza kuwangula bizibu, tekulina buyinza kuleeta biva mu kwo ebyeyoleka, oba okufuna obuwanguzi obujjuvu. Tulina okusooka okuwangula Katonda, nga tetunnawangula kwegayirira kwaffe.

Isaaya yatunuulira mu maaso n’amaaso ag’essuubi olunaku eddiini lwe yandikulaakulanye, ebiseera eby’okusaba okwa nnamaddala lwe byandibaddewo. Ebiseera ebyo bwe byandituuse, abakuumi tebandikendeezezza bwegendereza bwabwe, wabula bandikaabye emisana n’ekiro, era abo, abaali abajjukiza ba Mukama, tebandimuwadde kuwummula. Okufuba kwabwe okw’amaanyi era okutaddirira kwandikuumye ensonga zonna ez’omwoyo nga zikola, era kwandyeyongedde okusena mu by’obugagga bya Katonda ebitaggwaawo.

Okusaba okw’okwetayirira tekuggwaamu mwoyo era tekukoowa; tekuggwaamu maanyi; tekugonda eri buti, wabula kuwanirirwa era kunywezebwa essuubi eritamanyi kuggwaamu ssuubi, n’okukkiriza okutayinza kuta. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira kulina okugumiikiriza okulindirira n’amaanyi okugenda mu maaso. Tekwetegekera kulekera awo kusaba, era kugaana okuyimuka ku maviivi okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kufunibwa.

Ebigambo ebimanyiddwa, naye ebizzaamu amaanyi, eby’omuminsani oyo omukulu, Adoniram Judson, bwe bujulizi bw’omuntu eyali eyeetayirira mu kusaba. Agamba nti:

"Saali ayagala nnyo kintu kyonna, wadde okukisabira n’obwesimbu n’obumalirivu, ne kitajja ku kiseera ekimu, ne bwe lwandibadde olunaku olw’ewala ennyo. Mu ngeri emu oba endala, mu ndabika emu, oboolyawo gye nnandisembyeyo okulowooza, kyajja."

"Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo." Gano ge masomooza ag’amaanyi aga Mukama waffe ku nsonga y’okusaba, era kwe kulaga kwe nti okusaba okwa nnamaddala kulina okunywerera, n’okweyongera mu kufuba n’obumalirivu, okutuusa okusaba lwe kuddibwamu, n’omukisa ogunoonyezebwa ne gufunibwa.

Mu bigambo ebisatu musabe, munoonye, mukonkone, mu nsengeka gy’abiteekamu, Yesu akubiriza obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira mu kusaba. Okusaba, okunoonya, okukonkona, madaala agalinnya mu ssiraamu y’okusaba okuwangula. Tewali musingi Kristo gw’akaatiriza nnyo okusinga guno nti okusaba okuwangula kulina okubaamu empisa erindirira era enyiikira, obuvumu obutalekulira, okugumiikiriza okutakoowa, n’okumalirira okutakankana.

Mu lugero olukulembera olwa Mukwano Ekiro mu Ttumbi, mulimu ekyokuyiga ekikulu ennyo era ekiyigiriza ku nsonga eno. Obuvumu obutawangulika, okunywerera okutakoma, okumalirira ekigendererwa, bye bisinga mu mpisa ezizingirwa mu ndowooza ya Kristo ku ngeri y’okusaba esinga obukulu era esinga okuwangula.

Okwetayirira kukolebwa mu bumalirivu, okunyiikira, okugumiikiriza n’okunywerera. Okulwawo okulabika mu kuddamu okusaba gwe musingi era kye kyetaagisa okwetayirira. Mu kyokulabirako ekisooka ekiwandiikiddwa eky’ekyamagero ekyakolerwa ku muzibe w’amaaso, nga Matayo bw’akiwandiika, tufuna ekyokulabirako ky’engeri Mukama waffe gye yalabika ng’atawuliriza mangu abo abaamunoonya. Naye abazibe b’amaaso ababiri beeyongera okukaaba, ne bamugoberera n’okwegayirira kwabwe okutakoma, nga bagamba nti, "Ayi Omwana wa Dawudi, otusaasire!" Naye n’atabaddamu, n’ayingira mu nnyumba. Naye abali mu bwetaavu ne bamugoberera, era, ku nkomerero, ne bafuna okulaba kwabwe n’ekyo kye baali beegayirira.

Ensonga ya muzibe Battimaayo ya kitalo mu ngeri nnyingi. Okusingira ddala, yeeyoleka olw’okunywerera omuzibe ono kwe yalaga mu kwegayirira Mukama waffe. Bwe kiba — nga bwe kirabika — nti okukaaba kwe okusooka kwakolebwa Yesu ng’ayingira mu Yeriko, era nti yakugenda mu maaso okutuusa Yesu lwe yava mu kifo ekyo, kino kyongera okuba ekyokulabirako eky’amaanyi eky’obwetaavu bw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira, n’obuwanguzi obujjira abo abateeka byonna byabwe ku Kristo, ne batamuwa mirembe okutuusa lw’abawa okwegomba kw’emitima gyabwe.

Makko atuteekera mu maaso ensonga yonna mu ngeri erabika obulungi. Mu kusooka, Yesu alabika ng’atawulira. Ekibiina kinenya oluyoogaano lwa Battimaayo. Newaakubadde nga Mukama waffe alabika ng’atafaayo, era newaakubadde ng’ekibiina ekitagumiikiriza era ekisunguwala amangu kimunenya, omusabiriza omuzibe akyakaaba, era ayongera eddoboozi ly’okukaaba kwe, okutuusa Yesu lw’akwatibwako era n’akyuka. Ku nkomerero, ekibiina, nga ne Yesu, bawuliriza okwegayirira kw’omusabiriza ne balangirira nti bawagira ensonga ye. Ensonga ye agiwangula. Okwetayirira kwe kukola wadde mu maaso g’obutafaayo obulabika ku ludda lwa Yesu, era newaakubadde nga waliwo okuziyiza n’okunenya okuva mu kibiina ekyali kimwetoolodde. Okunywerera kwe kwawangula awo obutafaayo obw’omutima ogw’ekitundu we bwandiremereddwa ddala.

Okukkiriza kulina ekifo kyakwo, mu kusaba, era, mazima ddala, kulina akakwate akatayawukana n’okwetayirira. Naye okwetayirira kwe kusindiikiriza okusaba okutuuka ku ddaala ery’okukkiriza. Omwoyo ogunywerera gutuusa omuntu mu kifo okukkiriza we kukwatira, ne kwesigaanya, era ne kwefunira omukisa.

Obwetaavu obutasoboka kwewalika obw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira bulagiddwa lwatu mu Kigambo kya Katonda, era bwetaaga okwogerwako n’okuddamu okwogerwako leero. Tutera okubuusa amaaso amazima gano amakulu ennyo. Okwagala okuwummulira, obugayaavu mu by’omwoyo, obunafu mu by’eddiini, byonna bikola okulwanyisa engeri eno ey’okwegayirira. Naye okusaba kwaffe kwetaaga okunyigirizibwa n’okugobererwa n’amaanyi agatakoowa, okunywerera okutayinza kugaanibwa, n’obuvumu obutalemererwa.

Twetaaga, nate, okulowooza ku nsonga eyo ey’ekyama ey’okusaba — obukakafu nti wajja kubaawo okulwawo, okugaanibwa, n’okulemererwa okulabika, mu kukozesa okusaba. Tulina okubyetegekera, okubigumiikiriza, n’obutalekera awo kusaba kwaffe okw’amaanyi. Ng’omuserikale omuzira, olutalo bwe lweyongera okukaluba, alaga obuvumu obusinga obw’omu bitundu by’olutalo ebisooka; bw’atyo Omukristaayo asaba, okulwawo n’okugaanibwa bwe bimwolekera, ayongera okusaba kwe okw’amaanyi, era talekera awo okutuusa okusaba lwe kuwangula. Musa awa ekyokulabirako ekyeyoleka eky’okwetayirira mu kusaba. Mu kifo ky’okuleka okumpi kwe ne Katonda n’omukwano gwe naye okumuggyako obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira, abitwala ng’ebisinga okumusaanyiza okukukozesa. Isirayiri bwe baakola ennyana eya zaabu, obusungu bwa Katonda ne bubuubuuka nnyo gye bali, era Yakuwa, ng’amaliridde okutuukiriza obwenkanya, n’agamba Musa bwe yali amubikkulira ky’ateekateeka okukola nti, "ndeka!" Naye Musa teyakkiriza kumuleka. Yeeyala wansi mu maaso ga Mukama mu kulumwa okw’okwegayirira ku lw’Abayisirayiri abaali boonoonye, era okumala ennaku amakumi ana emisana n’ekiro, n’asiiba era n’asaba. Ng’ekyo kyali kiseera kya kusaba okw’okwetayirira!

Yakuwa yasunguwalira ne Alooni, eyali omukulembeze mu nsonga eno ey’okusinza ebifaananyi ey’ennyana eya zaabu. Naye Musa yasabira Alooni wamu n’Abayisirayiri; singa teyakikola, Isirayiri ne Alooni bandizikiridde, wansi w’omuliro ogwokya ogw’obusungu bwa Katonda.

Ekiseera ekyo ekiwanvu eky’okwegayirira mu maaso ga Katonda kyaleka akabonero ak’amaanyi ku Musa. Yali amaze okubeera mu nkolagana ey’okumpi ne Katonda edda, naye empisa ze tezaatuuka ku bukulu obwazeeyolekamu mu nnaku n’emyaka egyaddirira ekiseera kino ekiwanvu eky’okwegayirira okw’okwetayirira.

Tewali kubuusabuusa nti okusaba okw’okwetayirira kukyusa Katonda, era kugulumiza empisa z’omuntu! Singa twali ne Katonda nnyo mu kiragiro kino ekikulu eky’okwegayirira, amaaso gaffe gandyakaayakana nnyo, obulamu n’obuweereza bwandigaggawadde nnyo, n’empisa ezifunira omuntu okwagalibwa abantu, era ezireetera Erinnya lya Katonda ekitiibwa.
fields.body_text: "Ebitundu bibiri ku bisatu eby’okusaba kwe tukola, kuba kwa bintu ebyandituleetedde essanyu erisingayo bwe twandibifunye. Kika kya kwesanyusa mu by’omwoyo kye twenyigiramu, era olw’ekyo kye kifaananyi ekikontana ddala n’okwefuga. Katonda ekyo kyonna akimanyi, era akuuma abaana be nga basaba. Ekiseera bwe kiyitawo — mu kiseera kye — okwegayirira kwaffe kufuna endabika endala, naffe ne tufuna engeri endala ey’okusemberera mu by’omwoyo. Katonda atukuuma nga tusaba okutuusa, mu magezi ge, lw’asiima okuddamu. Era ne bwe kiba kimala bbanga ddene litya nga tannayogera, n’olwo kiba kya mangu nnyo okusinga bwe tulina eddembe okusuubira oba okusuubira okusaanira." — ATAMANYIKIDDWA. EKIGENDERERWA ky’enjigiriza za Kristo kwe kulangirira nti abantu basaanidde okusaba n’amaanyi — okusaba n’obumalirivu obutayinza kugaanibwa. Eggulu lirina amatu agawuliriza abo bokka abalina omutima gwonna, n’abamalirivu ennyo. Amaanyi, obuvumu, n’okunyiikira okutaddirira birina okuwagira okusaba eggulu kwe lissaamu ekitiibwa, era Katonda kw’awulira. Empisa zino zonna ez’emmeeme, ezeetaagisa ennyo mu kusaba okulina amaanyi, zirabikira mu lugero lw’omusajja eyagenda ewa mukwano gwe okusaba emigaati, mu ttumbi. Omusajja ono yagenda ku mulimu gwe ng’alina obwesige. Omukwano gwamusuubiza okutuuka ku buwanguzi. Okwegayirira kwe kwali kwa bwangu: mazima, teyayinza kuddayo ngalo nsa. Okugaanibwa okw’olwatu kwamunakuwaza era ne kumwewuunyisa. Wano n’omukwano gwalemererwa! Naye waaliwo ekintu ekyali kikyasigadde okugezaako — okumalirira okw’amaanyi, okumalirira okunywevu era okutakyukakyuka. Yali wa kusigala n’anyigiriza okusaba kwe okutuusa oluggi lwe lwandiggulwawo, n’okusaba kwe ne kukkirizibwa. Kino kye yakola, era olw’amaanyi g’okwetayirira n’afuna ekyo okusaba okwa bulijjo kye kwali kulemereddwa okufuna. Obuwanguzi bw’omusajja ono, obwafunibwa mu maaso g’okugaanibwa okw’olwatu, Omulokozi yabukozesa okulaga obwetaavu bw’okunywerera mu kwegayirira ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka ey’ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Okuddibwamu bwe kutaweebwa mangu ago, Omukristaayo asaba alina okukuŋŋaanya obuvumu buli lwe kulwawo, era yeeyongere okunyiikira okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kujja, okukakasiddwa, singa abeera n’okukkiriza okunyigiriza okwegayirira kwe n’okukkiriza okw’amaanyi. Obugayaavu, okuggwaamu omwoyo, obutagumiikiriza, n’okutya bijja kuzikiriza okusaba kwaffe. Ekirindirira okulumba kw’okwetayirira kwaffe n’okunywerera kwaffe gwe mutima gwa Kitaffe, omukono gwa Kitaffe, amaanyi ga Kitaffe agatakoma, n’okwagala kwa Kitaffe okutakoma okuwulira n’okuwa abaana be. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira kwe kutambula okw’amaanyi okw’omunda okw’omutima okugenda eri Katonda. Kwe kussa amaanyi gonna ag’omuntu ow’omwoyo mu kusaba. Isaaya yakungubaga nti tewali n’omu eyewalirizanga okukwata ku Katonda. Okusaba kungi kwakolebwanga mu biseera bya Isaaya, naye kwali kwangu nnyo, kwa bugayaavu era kwa kwematira. Tewaaliwo kutambula kwa maanyi okw’emmeeme okugenda eri Katonda. Tewaaliwo maanyi matukuvu agasimbye ennyiriri nga gamaliridde okutuuka ku Katonda n’okumeggana naye, okuggya gy’ali eby’obugagga eby’ekisa kye. Okusaba okutaliimu maanyi tekulina buyinza kuwangula bizibu, tekulina buyinza kuleeta biva mu kwo ebyeyoleka, oba okufuna obuwanguzi obujjuvu. Tulina okusooka okuwangula Katonda, nga tetunnawangula kwegayirira kwaffe. Isaaya yatunuulira mu maaso n’amaaso ag’essuubi olunaku eddiini lwe yandikulaakulanye, ebiseera eby’okusaba okwa nnamaddala lwe byandibaddewo. Ebiseera ebyo bwe byandituuse, abakuumi tebandikendeezezza bwegendereza bwabwe, wabula bandikaabye emisana n’ekiro, era abo, abaali abajjukiza ba Mukama, tebandimuwadde kuwummula. Okufuba kwabwe okw’amaanyi era okutaddirira kwandikuumye ensonga zonna ez’omwoyo nga zikola, era kwandyeyongedde okusena mu by’obugagga bya Katonda ebitaggwaawo. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira tekuggwaamu mwoyo era tekukoowa; tekuggwaamu maanyi; tekugonda eri buti, wabula kuwanirirwa era kunywezebwa essuubi eritamanyi kuggwaamu ssuubi, n’okukkiriza okutayinza kuta. Okusaba okw’okwetayirira kulina okugumiikiriza okulindirira n’amaanyi okugenda mu maaso. Tekwetegekera kulekera awo kusaba, era kugaana okuyimuka ku maviivi okutuusa okuddibwamu lwe kufunibwa. Ebigambo ebimanyiddwa, naye ebizzaamu amaanyi, eby’omuminsani oyo omukulu, Adoniram Judson, bwe bujulizi bw’omuntu eyali eyeetayirira mu kusaba. Agamba nti: "Saali ayagala nnyo kintu kyonna, wadde okukisabira n’obwesimbu n’obumalirivu, ne kitajja ku kiseera ekimu, ne bwe lwandibadde olunaku olw’ewala ennyo. Mu ngeri emu oba endala, mu ndabika emu, oboolyawo gye nnandisembyeyo okulowooza, kyajja." "Musabe, munaaweebwa. Munoonye, munaazuula. Era mukonkone munaggulirwawo." Gano ge masomooza ag’amaanyi aga Mukama waffe ku nsonga y’okusaba, era kwe kulaga kwe nti okusaba okwa nnamaddala kulina okunywerera, n’okweyongera mu kufuba n’obumalirivu, okutuusa okusaba lwe kuddibwamu, n’omukisa ogunoonyezebwa ne gufunibwa. Mu bigambo ebisatu musabe, munoonye, mukonkone, mu nsengeka gy’abiteekamu, Yesu akubiriza obwetaavu bw’okwetayirira mu kusaba. Okusaba, okunoonya, okukonkona, madaala agalinnya mu ssiraamu y’okusaba okuwangula. Tewali musingi Kristo gw’akaatiriza nnyo okusinga guno nti okusaba okuwangula kulina okubaamu empisa erindirira era enyiikira, obuvumu obutalekulira, okugumiikiriza okutakoowa, n’okumalirira okutakankana. Mu lugero olukulembera olwa Mukwano Ekiro mu Ttumbi, mulimu ekyokuyiga ekikulu ennyo era ekiyigiriza ku nsonga eno. Obuvumu obutawangulika, okunywerera okutakoma, okumalirira ekigendererwa, bye bisinga mu mpisa ezizingirwa mu ndowooza ya Kristo ku ngeri y’okusaba esinga obukulu era esinga okuwangula. Okwetayirira kukolebwa mu bumalirivu, okunyiikira, okugumiikiriza n’okunywerera. Okulwawo okulabika mu kuddamu okusaba gwe musingi era kye kyetaagisa okwetayirira. Mu kyokulabirako ekisooka ekiwandiikiddwa eky’ekyamagero ekyakolerwa ku muzibe w’amaaso, nga Matayo bw’akiwandiika, tufuna ekyokulabirako ky’engeri Mukama waffe gye yalabika ng’atawuliriza mangu abo abaamunoonya. Naye abazibe b’amaaso ababiri beeyongera okukaaba, ne bamugoberera n’okwegayirira kwabwe okutakoma, nga bagamba nti, "Ayi Omwana wa Dawudi, otusaasire!" Naye n’atabaddamu, n’ayingira mu nnyumba. Naye abali mu bwetaavu ne bamugoberera, era, ku nkomerero, ne bafuna okulaba kwabwe n’ekyo kye baali beegayirira. Ensonga ya muzibe Battimaayo ya kitalo mu ngeri nnyingi. Okusingira ddala, yeeyoleka olw’okunywerera omuzibe ono kwe yalaga mu kwegayirira Mukama waffe. Bwe kiba — nga bwe kirabika — nti okukaaba kwe okusooka kwakolebwa Yesu ng’ayingira mu Yeriko, era nti yakugenda mu maaso okutuusa Yesu lwe yava mu kifo ekyo, kino kyongera okuba ekyokulabirako eky’amaanyi eky’obwetaavu bw’okusaba okw’okwetayirira, n’obuwanguzi obujjira abo abateeka byonna byabwe ku Kristo, ne batamuwa mirembe okutuusa lw’abawa okwegomba kw’emitima gyabwe. Makko atuteekera mu maaso ensonga yonna mu ngeri erabika obulungi. Mu kusooka, Yesu alabika ng’atawulira. Ekibiina kinenya oluyoogaano lwa Battimaayo. Newaakubadde nga Mukama waffe alabika ng’atafaayo, era newaakubadde ng’ekibiina ekitagumiikiriza era ekisunguwala amangu kimunenya, omusabiriza omuzibe akyakaaba, era ayongera eddoboozi ly’okukaaba kwe, okutuusa Yesu lw’akwatibwako era n’akyuka. Ku nkomerero, ekibiina, nga ne Yesu, bawuliriza okwegayirira kw’omusabiriza ne balangirira nti bawagira ensonga ye. Ensonga ye agiwangula. Okwetayirira kwe kukola wadde mu maaso g’obutafaayo obulabika ku ludda lwa Yesu, era newaakubadde nga waliwo okuziyiza n’okunenya okuva mu kibiina ekyali kimwetoolodde. Okunywerera kwe kwawangula awo obutafaayo obw’omutima ogw’ekitundu we bwandiremereddwa ddala. Omwoyo ogunywerera gutuusa omuntu mu kifo okukkiriza we kukwatira, ne kwesigaanya, era ne kwefunira omukisa. fields.title: Okusaba n’Empisa n’Enneeyisa
fields.body_html:
"Jenero Charles James Gordon, omuzira w’e Khartum, yali muserikale Mukristaayo ddala. Bwe yasibirwa mu kibuga ky’e Sudan, yagumira n’obuzira okumala omwaka mulamba, naye, ku nkomerero, n’awangulwa era n’attibwa. Ku kijjukizo kye mu Westminster Abbey kuliko ebigambo bino, 'Ensimbi ze yaziwa abaavu; okusaasira kwe abaali mu nnaku; obulamu bwe ensi ye, n’emmeeme ye Katonda.'" — HOMER W. HODGE.

OKUSABA kufuga enneeyisa, n’enneeyisa ezimba empisa. Enneeyisa kye tukola; empisa kye tuli. Enneeyisa bwe bulamu obw’okungulu. Empisa bwe bulamu obutalabika, obukwekeddwa munda, naye nga bulagibwa ekyo ekiri ekirabika. Enneeyisa ya kungulu, erabibwa okuva ebweru; empisa ya munda — ekolera munda. Mu nteekateeka y’ekisa enneeyisa ye mwana w’empisa. Empisa ye mbeera y’omutima, enneeyisa kwe kwolesebwa kwayo okw’okungulu. Empisa gwe mulandira gw’omuti, enneeyisa, kye kibala kye gubala.

Okusaba kulina akakwate n’ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa. Ku mpisa n’enneeyisa, akakwate kaakwo ka muyambi. Okusaba kuyamba okunyweza empisa n’okubumba enneeyisa, era byombi okusobola okugenda mu maaso obulungi byesigama ku kusaba. Wayinza okubaawo ekigero ky’empisa ennungi n’enneeyisa awatali kusaba, naye tewayinza kubaawo kintu kyonna kifaanana ng’empisa ey’eddiini eyeeyawula n’enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo awatali kwo. Okusaba kuyamba, awo obuyambi obulala bwonna we bulemererwa. Gye tukoma okusaba, gye tukoma okuba abalungi, obulamu bwaffe ne bweyongera okuba obulongoofu era obulungi.

Enkomerero yennyini n’ekigendererwa ky’omulimu gwa Kristo ogw’okutangirira kwe kutonda empisa ey’eddiini n’okuzaala enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo.

"eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna, era yeerongooseza eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi."

Mu kuyigiriza kwa Kristo, si bikolwa bya kuyamba bwokka n’ebikolwa eby’okusaasira by’akaatiriza, wabula empisa ey’omwoyo ey’omunda. Kino kyetaagibwa, era tewali kitono ku kyo, ekiyinza okumala.

Mu kuyiga Ebbaluwa za Pawulo, waliwo ekintu kimu ekyeyoleka, mu ngeri entangaavu era etali ya kubuusabuusa — okukaatiriza obutukuvu bw’omutima, n’obutuukirivu bw’obulamu. Pawulo tanoonya nnyo kukubiriza ekiyitibwa "omulimu ogw’omuntu kinnoomu," era omulamwa omukulu ogw’ebbaluwa ze si bikolwa bya kuyamba. Embeera y’omutima gw’omuntu n’obulamu bw’omuntu obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa, bye bikola omugugu gw’ebiwandiiko bya Pawulo Omutukuvu.

Awalala mu Byawandiikibwa, nawo, empisa n’enneeyisa bye biweebwa ekifo ekisooka. Eddiini ey’Ekikristaayo ekola ku bantu abatalina mpisa ya mwoyo, era abatali batukuvu mu bulamu, era egenderera okubakyusa, bafuuke abatukuvu mu mutima era abatuukirivu mu bulamu. Egenderera okukyusa abantu ababi okuba abantu abalungi; ekola ku bubi obw’omunda, era ekola okubukyusa okuba obulungi obw’omunda. Era wano okusaba we kuyingirira ne kulaga amaanyi gaakwo ag’ekitalo n’ebibala byakwo. Okusaba kusindiikiriza okutuuka ku nkomerero eyo yennyini. Mu butuufu, awatali kusaba, tewali nkyukakyuka ng’eyo ey’ekyamagero mu mpisa y’omuntu, eyinza okukolebwa. Kubanga enkyukakyuka okuva mu bubi okudda mu bulungi tekolebwa "si lwa bikolwa eby’omu butuukirivu bye twakola," wabula olw’okusaasira kwa Katonda, okutulokola "mu kunaazibwa okw’okuzaalibwa okw’omulundi ogwokubiri." Era enkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo ereetebwawo okuyitira mu kusaba okw’amaanyi, okunyiikivu, era okwesigwa. Engeri yonna eyeeyita Obukristaayo, etaleeta nkyukakyuka eno mu mitima gy’abantu, bulimba era mutego.

Omulimu gw’okusaba kwe kukyusa empisa n’enneeyisa z’abantu, era mu mirundi egitabalika, kino kikoleddwa okusaba. Wano, okusaba, olw’obujulizi bwakwo, kukakasizza nti kuva eri Katonda. Era nga bwe guli omulimu gw’okusaba okukola kino, bwe gutyo omulimu omukulu ogw’Ekkanisa kwe kukwata abantu ababi n’okubafuula abalungi. Omulimu gwayo kwe kukyusa obuntu, okukyusa empisa, okukwata ku nneeyisa, okukyusiza ddala enneeyisa. Ekkanisa esuubirwa okuba entuukirivu, era esaanidde okuba ng’ekyusa abantu okudda eri obutuukirivu. Ekkanisa kye kkolero lya Katonda ku nsi, era omulimu gwayo omukulu kwe kutonda n’okukuza obutuukirivu bw’empisa. Guno gwe mulimu gwayo ogusooka ddala. Okusookera ddala, omulimu gwayo si kufuna bammemba, wadde okukuŋŋaanya obungi, wadde okugenderera okufuna ensimbi, wadde okwenyigira mu bikolwa by’okuyamba n’eby’okusaasira, wabula okuzaala obutuukirivu bw’empisa, n’obulongoofu bw’obulamu obw’okungulu.

Ekikolebwa kiraga era kigabana ku mpisa y’ekkolero erikikola. Ekkanisa entuukirivu erina ekigendererwa ekituukirivu ekola abantu abatuukirivu. Okusaba kuzaala obulongoofu bw’omutima n’obulongoofu bw’obulamu. Tekuyinza kuzaala kirala. Enneeyisa etali ntuukirivu ezaalibwa obutasaba; byombi bitambulira wamu. Okusaba n’okwonoona tebiyinza kutambulira wamu. Kimu, oba ekirala, kirina, olw’obwetaavu, okukoma. Leetera abantu okusaba, era bajja kulekera awo okwonoona, kubanga okusaba kuleeta okukyawa ekibi, era kukola bwe kutyo ku mutima, ne kiba nti okukola ebibi kufuuka ekyenyinyalwa, n’obuntu bwonna ne bugulumizibwa okulowooza n’okussaamu ekitiibwa ebintu ebya waggulu era ebitukuvu.

Okusaba kwesigamye ku mpisa. Kye tuli eri Katonda kye kipima obuyinza bwaffe gy’ali. Gwali mpisa ey’omunda, so si ndabika ey’okungulu, ey’abantu nga Ibulayimu, Yobu, Dawudi, Musa n’abalala bonna, abaali n’obuyinza bungi eri Katonda mu nnaku ez’edda. Era, leero, si bigambo byaffe nnyo, wabula kye tuli ddala, ekizitowa eri Katonda. Enneeyisa ekwata ku mpisa, kya mazima, era ebalibwa nnyo mu kusaba kwaffe. Naye mu kiseera kye kimu, empisa ekwata ku nneeyisa okusingira ddala, era erina obuyinza obusingako ku kusaba. Obulamu bwaffe obw’omunda tebuwa kusaba kwaffe langi kyokka, wabula n’omubiri gwakwo. Obulamu obubi butegeeza okusaba okubi, era, ku nkomerero, obutasaba n’akatono. Tusaba nga tuli banafu kubanga tubeera balamu nga tuli banafu. Omugga gw’okusaba tegusobola kulinnya waggulu okusinga ensulo y’obulamu. Amaanyi g’ekisenge eky’omunda gakolebwa mu maanyi agakulukuta okuva mu migga egyegatta egy’obulamu. N’obunafu bw’obulamu buva mu bunafu n’obutaba na mutindo obw’empisa.

Obunafu bw’obulamu bulaga obukoowu bwabwo n’okuggwaamu amaanyi mu biseera eby’okusaba. Mazima ddala tetuyinza kwogera na Katonda, n’amaanyi, mu kumpi, era n’obwesige okuggyako nga tubeerawo ku lulwe, mu bwesigwa era mu mazima. Ekisenge eky’omunda tekiyinza kutukuzibwa eri Katonda, obulamu bwe buba nga bwawukana n’ebiragiro bye n’ekigendererwa kye. Tulina okuyiga ekyokuyiga kino obulungi — nti empisa entuukirivu n’enneeyisa efaanana nga Kristo bituwa ekifo eky’enjawulo era eky’enkizo mu kusaba mu maaso ga Katonda. Ekigambo kye ekitukuvu kikaatiriza nnyo omugabo enneeyisa gw’erina mu kuwa okusaba kwaffe omuwendo bwe kirangirira nti:

"Olwo olikoowoola, Mukama n’akuddamu; olikaaba naye n’akuddamu nti, Ndi wano. Bwe muliggyawo ekikoligo ekinyigiriza n’okusonga ennwe, n’okwogera n’ejjoogo;"

Obubi bwa Isirayiri n’ebikolwa byabwe eby’omuzizo Isaaya yabyogerako lwatu, ng’ensonga lwaki Katonda yandikyusizza amatu ge okuva ku kusaba kwabwe:

"Bwe munaayimusanga emikono gyammwe musabe nnaabakwekanga amaaso gange, era ne bwe munaasabanga ennyo siiwulirenga kubanga emikono gyammwe gisaabaanye omusaayi."

Amazima ge gamu ag’ennaku Mukama yagalangirira okuyitira mu kamwa ka Yeremiya:

"Noolwekyo tosabira bantu bano, tobakaabiririra wadde okubegayiririra kubanga siribawulira mu biro lwe baligwako akabi."

Wano, kyogeddwa lwatu, nti enneeyisa etali ntukuvu kiziyiza okusaba okuwangula, nga bwe kiragiddwa obulungi nti, okusobola okufuna ekkubo eddene eri Katonda mu kusaba, wateekwa okubaawo okulekerawo ddala ekibi kye tumanyi era kye tugenderera.

Tulagirwa okusaba, "nga bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu, nga tebalina busungu wadde empaka," era tulina okumala ekiseera ky’okutambula kwaffe wano, nga twewala ddala obubi bwe tuba ab’okusigaza enkizo yaffe ey’okukoowoola Kitaffe. Tetuyinza, mu ngeri yonna, kwawula kusaba ku nneeyisa.

"Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa."

Era Yakobo alangirira lwatu nti abantu basaba ne batafuna, kubanga basaba bubi, era banoonya kwesanyusa mu kwegomba kwabwe okw’okwefaako bokka.

Ekiragiro kya Mukama waffe, "Mutunule nga musaba Katonda buli kiseera," kigendereddwa okubikka n’okukuuma enneeyisa yaffe yonna, tulyoke tujje mu kisenge kyaffe eky’omunda ng’amaanyi gaakwo gonna gakuumibwa omukuumi atunula ennyo ku bulamu bwaffe.

"Mwekuume muleme okwemalira mu binyumu n’okutamiira, n’okweraliikirira eby’obulamu, okujja kwange okw’amangu kuleme kubakwasa nga temugenderedde ng’abagudde mu mutego."

Emirundi mingi, obumanyirivu bw’Ekikristaayo bwekoona ku lwazi lw’enneeyisa. Endowooza ennungi zonoonebwa obulamu obw’ensonyi. Ekisinga obuzibu mu kutya Katonda, era ekisinga okukwata ku bantu, kwe kusobola okukutambuliramu. Obulamu bwe bubalibwa, era okusaba kwaffe kubonaabona, nga n’ebitundu ebirala eby’obumanyirivu bwaffe obw’eddiini bwe bibonaabona, olw’obulamu obubi.

Mu biseera eby’edda ababuulizi baalagirwanga okubuulira n’obulamu bwabwe, oba obutabuulira n’akatono. Bwe kityo, leero, Abakristaayo, buli wamu, basaanidde okulagirwa okusaba n’obulamu bwabwe, oba obutasaba n’akatono. Okubuulira okusinga okukola si kwe kuwulirwa okuva ku kituuti, wabula okwo okulangirirwa mu kasirise, mu bwetoowaze era mu ngeri etakyukakyuka; okulaga obulungi bwakwo awaka, ne mu kitundu. Ekyokulabirako kibuulira omusomo ogukola ennyo okusinga okuyigiriza okw’ebigambo. Okubuulira okusinga, wadde ku kituuti, kwe kunywezebwa okutya Katonda mu bulamu bw’omubuulizi yennyini. Omulimu ogusinga okukola ogw’abo abatuula mu ntebe gukulemberwa, era gugenderwako, obutukuvu bw’obulamu, okweyawula ku nsi, okwesala ku kibi. Ebimu ku byegayiro ebisinga amaanyi bikolebwa n’emimwa egisirika — bakitaabwe abatya Katonda ne bannyaabwe abatukuvu abaali, nga batudde ku muliro mu maka, batya Katonda, baagala omulimu gwe, era buli lunaku nga balaga abaana baabwe n’abalala ababeetoolodde, obulungi n’ebirungi eby’obulamu n’enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo.

Omusomo ogusinga okutegekebwa, ogusinga obulungi mu kwogera, guyinza okwonoonebwa ne gufuulibwa ogutaliiko kye gukola, olw’ebikolwa ebibuusibwabuusibwa mu mubuulizi. Omukozi w’ekkanisa asinga okunyiikira ayinza okwonoonebwa omulimu gw’emikono gye olw’omwoyo ogw’ensi n’obulamu obutakwatagana. Abantu babuulira n’obulamu bwabwe, so si n’ebigambo byabwe, era emisomo gibuulirwa, si nnyo mu, era okuva ku kituuti, wabula mu mbeera z’omwoyo, mu bikolwa, ne mu bintu enkumi n’enkumi ebijjuza ekkubo ly’obulamu obwa buli lunaku.

Kya mazima, okusaba kw’okwenenya Katonda akukkiriza. Asanyukira okuwulira okukaaba kw’aboonoonyi abeenenya. Naye okwenenya tekuzingiramu nnaku olw’ekibi kyokka, wabula n’okukyuka okuva ku kukola ebibi, n’okuyiga okukola obulungi. Okwenenya okutaleeta nkyukakyuka mu mpisa n’enneeyisa, bulimba bwokka, obutasaanidde kulimbalimba muntu yenna. Eby’edda biteekwa okuggwaawo, ebintu byonna biteekwa okufuuka ebiggya.

Okusaba, okutavaamu kulowooza kutuufu n’obulamu obutuufu, kya kusaaga. Tuba tusubiddwa omulimu gwonna ogw’okusaba bwe kuba nga tekulongoosa mpisa n’okutereeza enneeyisa. Tuba tulemereddwa ddala okutegeera amaanyi g’okusaba, bwe kuba nga tekuleeta nkyukakyuka ya ddala mu bulamu. Mu butonde bw’ebintu, tulina okulekera awo okusaba, oba enneeyisa yaffe embi. Okusaba okunnyogovu, okw’omukolo obukolo, kuyinza okubeerawo wamu, n’enneeyisa embi, naye okusaba okw’engeri eyo, mu maaso ga Katonda, si kusaba n’akatono. Okusaba kwaffe kweyongera amaanyi, nga bwe kukoma okutereeza obulamu. Okukula mu bulongoofu n’okwewaayo eri Katonda kujja kuba bulamu bwa kusaba nnyo.

Empisa y’obulamu obw’omunda kye kisaanyizo ky’okusaba okulina amaanyi. Ng’obulamu bwe buli, n’okusaba bwe kuliba. Obulamu obutakwatagana buziyiza okusaba era ne butta amaanyi g’okusaba okutono kwe tuyinza okukola. Bulijjo, kiri nti "Okusaba ... ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi." Mazima ddala, omuntu ayinza okweyongerayo n’alangirira, nti okusaba kw’omutuukirivu kwokka kwe kugasa ekintu kyonna — mu kiseera kyonna. Okubeera n’eriiso eritunuulira ekitiibwa kya Katonda; okubeera n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okumusanyusa mu makubo gaffe gonna; okubeera n’emikono egikola mu buweereza bwe; okubeera n’ebigere ebidduka amangu mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro bye — bino biwa okusaba obuzito n’obuyinza n’amaanyi, era bitufunira okuwulirwa Katonda. Omugugu ogunyigiriza obulamu bwaffe gutera okumenya amaanyi g’okusaba kwaffe, era, emirundi egitali mitono, gubeera ng’enzigi ez’ekikomo, mu maaso g’okusaba.

Okusaba kulina okuva mu mutima omulongoofu era kuleetebwe era kunyigirizibwe "nga bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu." Kulina okunywezebwa obulamu obugenderera, obutakoma, okugondera Katonda, okufaanana amateeka ga Katonda, n’okujja mu kwewaayo eri okwagala kwa Katonda.

Kireme kwerabirwa, nti, wadde ng’obulamu kisaanyizo ky’okusaba, okusaba nakwo kye kisaanyizo ky’obulamu obutuukirivu. Okusaba kukuza obulamu obutuukirivu, era kwe kuyamba okumu okukulu eri obugolokofu bw’omutima n’obulamu. Ekibala ky’okusaba okwa nnamaddala bwe bulamu obutuufu. Okusaba kuteeka oyo asaba ku mulimu omukulu, "okukola ebiraga nti mwalokolebwa, nga mutya era nga mukankana;" kumuteeka okwekuuma mu mbeera ye, mu njogera ye ne mu nneeyisa ye; kumuleetera "nga mutambula n’obwegendereza ... nga temwonoona biseera;" kumusobozesa "mubeere n’empisa ezisaanira obulamu bwe mwayitirwa okutambuliramu ... Mubeerenga bakkakkamu, abawombeefu;" kumuwa ensonga ey’amaanyi okugenda mu maaso n’olugendo lwe mu ngeri etakyukakyuka "nga yeewala buli kkubo ebbi, era ng’atambulira mu kirungi."

Bwe yasibirwa mu kibuga ky’e Sudan, yagumira n’obuzira okumala omwaka mulamba, naye, ku nkomerero, n’awangulwa era n’attibwa. Ku kijjukizo kye mu Westminster Abbey kuliko ebigambo bino, 'Ensimbi ze yaziwa abaavu; okusaasira kwe abaali mu nnaku; obulamu bwe ensi ye, n’emmeeme ye Katonda.'" — HOMER W. HODGE. OKUSABA kufuga enneeyisa, n’enneeyisa ezimba empisa. Enneeyisa kye tukola; empisa kye tuli. Enneeyisa bwe bulamu obw’okungulu. Empisa bwe bulamu obutalabika, obukwekeddwa munda, naye nga bulagibwa ekyo ekiri ekirabika. Enneeyisa ya kungulu, erabibwa okuva ebweru; empisa ya munda — ekolera munda. Mu nteekateeka y’ekisa enneeyisa ye mwana w’empisa. Empisa ye mbeera y’omutima, enneeyisa kwe kwolesebwa kwayo okw’okungulu. Empisa gwe mulandira gw’omuti, enneeyisa, kye kibala kye gubala. Okusaba kulina akakwate n’ebirabo byonna eby’ekisa. Ku mpisa n’enneeyisa, akakwate kaakwo ka muyambi. Okusaba kuyamba okunyweza empisa n’okubumba enneeyisa, era byombi okusobola okugenda mu maaso obulungi byesigama ku kusaba. Wayinza okubaawo ekigero ky’empisa ennungi n’enneeyisa awatali kusaba, naye tewayinza kubaawo kintu kyonna kifaanana ng’empisa ey’eddiini eyeeyawula n’enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo awatali kwo. Okusaba kuyamba, awo obuyambi obulala bwonna we bulemererwa. Gye tukoma okusaba, gye tukoma okuba abalungi, obulamu bwaffe ne bweyongera okuba obulongoofu era obulungi. Enkomerero yennyini n’ekigendererwa ky’omulimu gwa Kristo ogw’okutangirira kwe kutonda empisa ey’eddiini n’okuzaala enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo. "eyeewaayo ku lwaffe, alyoke atununule mu bujeemu bwaffe bwonna, era yeerongooseza eggwanga ery’envuma, erinyiikirira ebikolwa ebirungi." Mu kuyigiriza kwa Kristo, si bikolwa bya kuyamba bwokka n’ebikolwa eby’okusaasira by’akaatiriza, wabula empisa ey’omwoyo ey’omunda. Kino kyetaagibwa, era tewali kitono ku kyo, ekiyinza okumala. Mu kuyiga Ebbaluwa za Pawulo, waliwo ekintu kimu ekyeyoleka, mu ngeri entangaavu era etali ya kubuusabuusa — okukaatiriza obutukuvu bw’omutima, n’obutuukirivu bw’obulamu. Pawulo tanoonya nnyo kukubiriza ekiyitibwa "omulimu ogw’omuntu kinnoomu," era omulamwa omukulu ogw’ebbaluwa ze si bikolwa bya kuyamba. Embeera y’omutima gw’omuntu n’obulamu bw’omuntu obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa, bye bikola omugugu gw’ebiwandiiko bya Pawulo Omutukuvu. Awalala mu Byawandiikibwa, nawo, empisa n’enneeyisa bye biweebwa ekifo ekisooka. Eddiini ey’Ekikristaayo ekola ku bantu abatalina mpisa ya mwoyo, era abatali batukuvu mu bulamu, era egenderera okubakyusa, bafuuke abatukuvu mu mutima era abatuukirivu mu bulamu. Egenderera okukyusa abantu ababi okuba abantu abalungi; ekola ku bubi obw’omunda, era ekola okubukyusa okuba obulungi obw’omunda. Era wano okusaba we kuyingirira ne kulaga amaanyi gaakwo ag’ekitalo n’ebibala byakwo. Okusaba kusindiikiriza okutuuka ku nkomerero eyo yennyini. Mu butuufu, awatali kusaba, tewali nkyukakyuka ng’eyo ey’ekyamagero mu mpisa y’omuntu, eyinza okukolebwa. Era enkyukakyuka eno ey’ekitalo ereetebwawo okuyitira mu kusaba okw’amaanyi, okunyiikivu, era okwesigwa. Engeri yonna eyeeyita Obukristaayo, etaleeta nkyukakyuka eno mu mitima gy’abantu, bulimba era mutego.
