Obulamu bwe bubalibwa, era okusaba kwaffe kubonaabona, nga n’ebitundu ebirala eby’obumanyirivu bwaffe obw’eddiini bwe bibonaabona, olw’obulamu obubi. Mu biseera eby’edda ababuulizi baalagirwanga okubuulira n’obulamu bwabwe, oba obutabuulira n’akatono. Bwe kityo, leero, Abakristaayo, buli wamu, basaanidde okulagirwa okusaba n’obulamu bwabwe, oba obutasaba n’akatono. Okubuulira okusinga okukola si kwe kuwulirwa okuva ku kituuti, wabula okwo okulangirirwa mu kasirise, mu bwetoowaze era mu ngeri etakyukakyuka; okulaga obulungi bwakwo awaka, ne mu kitundu. Ekyokulabirako kibuulira omusomo ogukola ennyo okusinga okuyigiriza okw’ebigambo. Okubuulira okusinga, wadde ku kituuti, kwe kunywezebwa okutya Katonda mu bulamu bw’omubuulizi yennyini. Omulimu ogusinga okukola ogw’abo abatuula mu ntebe gukulemberwa, era gugenderwako, obutukuvu bw’obulamu, okweyawula ku nsi, okwesala ku kibi. Ebimu ku byegayiro ebisinga amaanyi bikolebwa n’emimwa egisirika — bakitaabwe abatya Katonda ne bannyaabwe abatukuvu abaali, nga batudde ku muliro mu maka, batya Katonda, baagala omulimu gwe, era buli lunaku nga balaga abaana baabwe n’abalala ababeetoolodde, obulungi n’ebirungi eby’obulamu n’enneeyisa ey’Ekikristaayo. Omusomo ogusinga okutegekebwa, ogusinga obulungi mu kwogera, guyinza okwonoonebwa ne gufuulibwa ogutaliiko kye gukola, olw’ebikolwa ebibuusibwabuusibwa mu mubuulizi. Omukozi w’ekkanisa asinga okunyiikira ayinza okwonoonebwa omulimu gw’emikono gye olw’omwoyo ogw’ensi n’obulamu obutakwatagana. Abantu babuulira n’obulamu bwabwe, so si n’ebigambo byabwe, era emisomo gibuulirwa, si nnyo mu, era okuva ku kituuti, wabula mu mbeera z’omwoyo, mu bikolwa, ne mu bintu enkumi n’enkumi ebijjuza ekkubo ly’obulamu obwa buli lunaku. Kya mazima, okusaba kw’okwenenya Katonda akukkiriza. Asanyukira okuwulira okukaaba kw’aboonoonyi abeenenya. Naye okwenenya tekuzingiramu nnaku olw’ekibi kyokka, wabula n’okukyuka okuva ku kukola ebibi, n’okuyiga okukola obulungi. Okwenenya okutaleeta nkyukakyuka mu mpisa n’enneeyisa, bulimba bwokka, obutasaanidde kulimbalimba muntu yenna. Eby’edda biteekwa okuggwaawo, ebintu byonna biteekwa okufuuka ebiggya. Okusaba, okutavaamu kulowooza kutuufu n’obulamu obutuufu, kya kusaaga. Tuba tusubiddwa omulimu gwonna ogw’okusaba bwe kuba nga tekulongoosa mpisa n’okutereeza enneeyisa. Tuba tulemereddwa ddala okutegeera amaanyi g’okusaba, bwe kuba nga tekuleeta nkyukakyuka ya ddala mu bulamu. Mu butonde bw’ebintu, tulina okulekera awo okusaba, oba enneeyisa yaffe embi. Okusaba okunnyogovu, okw’omukolo obukolo, kuyinza okubeerawo wamu, n’enneeyisa embi, naye okusaba okw’engeri eyo, mu maaso ga Katonda, si kusaba n’akatono. Okusaba kwaffe kweyongera amaanyi, nga bwe kukoma okutereeza obulamu. Okukula mu bulongoofu n’okwewaayo eri Katonda kujja kuba bulamu bwa kusaba nnyo. Empisa y’obulamu obw’omunda kye kisaanyizo ky’okusaba okulina amaanyi. Ng’obulamu bwe buli, n’okusaba bwe kuliba. Obulamu obutakwatagana buziyiza okusaba era ne butta amaanyi g’okusaba okutono kwe tuyinza okukola. Bulijjo, kiri nti "Okusaba ... ogw’omuntu omutuukirivu, kubeera n’obuyinza bungi." Mazima ddala, omuntu ayinza okweyongerayo n’alangirira, nti okusaba kw’omutuukirivu kwokka kwe kugasa ekintu kyonna — mu kiseera kyonna. Okubeera n’eriiso eritunuulira ekitiibwa kya Katonda; okubeera n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okumusanyusa mu makubo gaffe gonna; okubeera n’emikono egikola mu buweereza bwe; okubeera n’ebigere ebidduka amangu mu kkubo ly’ebiragiro bye — bino biwa okusaba obuzito n’obuyinza n’amaanyi, era bitufunira okuwulirwa Katonda. Omugugu ogunyigiriza obulamu bwaffe gutera okumenya amaanyi g’okusaba kwaffe, era, emirundi egitali mitono, gubeera ng’enzigi ez’ekikomo, mu maaso g’okusaba. Okusaba kulina okuva mu mutima omulongoofu era kuleetebwe era kunyigirizibwe "nga bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu." Kulina okunywezebwa obulamu obugenderera, obutakoma, okugondera Katonda, okufaanana amateeka ga Katonda, n’okujja mu kwewaayo eri okwagala kwa Katonda. Kireme kwerabirwa, nti, wadde ng’obulamu kisaanyizo ky’okusaba, okusaba nakwo kye kisaanyizo ky’obulamu obutuukirivu. Okusaba kukuza obulamu obutuukirivu, era kwe kuyamba okumu okukulu eri obugolokofu bw’omutima n’obulamu. Ekibala ky’okusaba okwa nnamaddala bwe bulamu obutuufu. Okusaba kuteeka oyo asaba ku mulimu omukulu, "okukola ebiraga nti mwalokolebwa, nga mutya era nga mukankana;" kumuteeka okwekuuma mu mbeera ye, mu njogera ye ne mu nneeyisa ye; kumuleetera "nga mutambula n’obwegendereza ... nga temwonoona biseera;" kumusobozesa "mubeere n’empisa ezisaanira obulamu bwe mwayitirwa okutambuliramu ... Mubeerenga bakkakkamu, abawombeefu;" kumuwa ensonga ey’amaanyi okugenda mu maaso n’olugendo lwe mu ngeri etakyukakyuka "nga yeewala buli kkubo ebbi, era ng’atambulira mu kirungi."

fields.title: Okusaba n’Obuwulize
fields.body_html:
"Mu Fletcher ow’e Madeley mwalabikamu obuwulize bwe nandyagadde okusobola okunnyonnyola oba okukoppa. Bwamuwa omutima omwetegefu okwaniriza buli musaalaba mangu era n’essanyu. Yalina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abaana b’endiga ab’ekisibo, era yafubanga nnyo okubayigiriza, ekyo kye yalinamu ekirabo eky’enjawulo. . . . Byonna bye yakolanga nange byali bitabuddwamu nnyo okusaba n’okutendereza, ne kiba nti buli mulimu, na buli kijjulo, byali ng’ebiwunyiddwako akaloosa kaabyo." — JOHN WESLEY.

MU MATEEKA ga Musa, obuwulize bwatwalibwanga nga "Okugonda kusinga ssaddaaka, era n’okuwuliriza kusinga amasavu g’endiga ennume." Mu kitabo ky’Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 5:29, Musa alaga Katonda Ayinzabyonna ng’ayogera ku mpisa eno yennyini mu ngeri etaleka kubuusabuusa kwonna ku bukulu bw’agiteekako. Ng’ayogera ku bukyamu bw’abantu be, akaaba nti:

"Singa nno bulijjo emitima gyabwe gibeera bwe gityo; ne bantya, era ne bagonderanga amateeka gange gonna, ne balyoka balaba ebirungi awamu n’abaana baabwe emirembe gyonna!"

Tewali kubuusabuusa nti obuwulize mpisa ya waggulu, mpisa ya muserikale. Okugonda kwa muserikale okusinga byonna. Lye ssomo lye ery’olubereberye n’ery’enkomerero, era alina okuyiga okukugoberera buli kiseera, awatali kwebuuza, era awatali kwemulugunya. Ate era obuwulize kwe kukkiriza nga kukola, era bwe bukulukuta okuva mu kwagala, nga bwe bugezesa okwagala ddala. "Oyo alina ebiragiro byange n’abikwata, oyo y’anjagala."

Ekirala: obuwulize bwe bukuuma okwagala era bwe bulamu bwakwo.

"Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange," Yesu bw’agamba, "olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ŋŋondera ebiragiro bya Kitange ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe."

Nga kino kigambo kya kitalo ekiraga enkolagana obuwulize gye buleeta era gye bukuuma! Omwana wa Katonda akuumibwa mu kifuba ky’okwagala kwa Kitaffe, olw’obuwulize bwe! Era ekisobozesa Omwana wa Katonda okubeera bulijjo mu kwagala kwa Kitaawe kibikkulwa mu kigambo kye yennyini: "Kubanga bulijjo nkola by’ayagala."

Ekirabo ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kigera ekijjuvu era mu bumanyirivu obusingawo obugagga, kyesigamye ku buwulize obw’okwagala:

"Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange," kye kigambo kya Mukama waffe. "Nange ndisaba Kitange n’abawa Omubeezi omulala anaabeeranga nammwe emirembe n’emirembe."

Okugondera Katonda kye kikakaso ky’okukulaakulana mu mwoyo, okumatira munda, n’obunywevu bw’omutima. "Bwe munaagondanga ne muwulira, munaalyanga ebirungi eby’ensi." Obuwulize buggulawo emiryango gy’Ekibuga Ekitukuvu, era buwa ekkubo eri omuti ogw’obulamu.

"Balina omukisa abo abakola ebiragiro bye, balyoke babe n’obuyinza ku muti ogw’obulamu, era bayingire mu kibuga nga bayita mu miryango."

Obuwulize kye ki? Kwe kukola Katonda by’ayagala: kwe kukwata ebiragiro bye. Biragiro bimeka ebiteekwa okukwatibwa obuwulize okuba obwannamaddala? Okukwata ekitundu kyabyo, n’okumenya ekitundu ekirala — obwo bwe buwulize obwannamaddala? Okukwata ebiragiro byonna okuggyako kimu — obwo bwe buwulize? Ku nsonga eno, Yakobo Omutume ayogera lwatu ddala: "Omuntu akwata amateeka gonna," bw’agamba, "naye n’asobyako erimu, omusango gumusinga mu ngeri y’emu ng’oli asobezza amateeka gonna."

Omwoyo ogusindiikiriza omuntu okumenya ekiragiro kimu gwe gumu oguyinza okumusindiikiriza okubimenya byonna. Ebiragiro bya Katonda kintu kimu, era okumenya ekimu kiba kulumba nnono eri wansi wa byonna era ebuna mu byonna. Oyo atalonzalonza kumenya kiragiro kimu — kino kirabika nnyo — bw’anaanyigirizibwa mu ngeri y’emu, era ng’ali mu mbeera ze zimu, yandibimenye byonna.

Okugonda mu byonna kwe kusabibwa abantu bonna. Tewali kirala kitali buwulize obujjuvu obutabuusabuusa ekiyinza okumatiza Katonda, era okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna kye kikakasa obuwulize obwo Katonda bw’ayagala. Naye tuyinza okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda byonna? Omuntu ayinza okufuna obusobozi obw’empisa obumusobozesa okugondera buli kimu ku byo? Ddala ayinza. Mu buli ngeri, omuntu ayinza, ng’ayita mu kusaba, okufuna obusobozi okukola ekyo kyennyini.

Katonda awa ebiragiro abantu bye batayinza kugondera? Ye mukakanyavu, akola nga bw’ayagala, muzibu, era atalina kwagala, n’okuwa ebiragiro ebitayinza kugonderwa? Okuddamu kwe kuti: mu byafaayo byonna eby’Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, tewali na kimu ekiwandiikiddwa nga Katonda yalagira omuntu yenna okukola ekintu ekyali kisukka amaanyi ge. Katonda mukyamu era talowooza ku bantu, n’okusaba omuntu ekyo ky’atasobola kuwa? Nedda ddala. Okulowooza bwe kityo kwe kuwaayiriza empisa ya Katonda.

Ka tulowooze ku kirowoozo kino akaseera katono: Abazadde ab’oku nsi basaba abaana baabwe okukola emirimu gye batayinza kukola? Taata ki ayinza n’okulowooza okuba omukyamu bw’atyo, era omunyigiriza bw’atyo? Katonda talina kisa n’obwenkanya okusinga abazadde ab’oku nsi abalina ebisobyo? Bo basinga obulungi n’obwenkanya Katonda atuukiridde? Nga kirowoozo kya busirusiru nnyo era ekitayinza kuyimirirawo!

Mu nnono, okugondera Katonda mpisa y’emu n’okugondera abazadde ab’oku nsi. Okutwalira awamu, kitegeeza okuleka ekkubo lyo, n’ogoberera ery’omulala; okuwaayo okwagala kwo eri okwagala kw’omulala; okwewaayo wansi w’obuyinza n’ebyo omuzadde by’ayagala. Ebiragiro, oba biva eri Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu oba eri kitaffe ow’oku nsi, bikulemberwa okwagala, era ebiragiro ng’ebyo byonna bigendererwamu obulungi bw’abo abalagirwa. Ebiragiro bya Katonda tebiweebwa mu bukambwe wadde mu kunyigiriza. Bulijjo biweebwa mu kwagala era ku lw’obulungi bwaffe, noolwekyo kitusaanira okubiwuliriza n’okubigondera. Mu bigambo ebirala, era nga tukipimira ku muwendo gwakyo ogusinga obutono — Katonda bw’aba nga yatuwa ebiragiro bye okutuleetera ebirungi, noolwekyo kitugasa okuba abawulize. Obuwulize buleeta empeera yaabwo. Katonda bw’atyo bwe yakiteekawo, era okuva bwe yakikola, n’amagezi g’omuntu gasobola okutegeera nti teyandisabye ekyo kye tutayinza kuwa.

Obuwulize kwe kwagala okutuukiriza buli kiragiro, kwe kwagala nga kweyoleka. N’olwekyo, obuwulize si kintu kizibu ekitusabibwa, okusinga obuweereza omusajja bw’awa mukazi we, oba omukazi bw’awa bba. Okwagala kusanyukira okugonda n’okusanyusa gwe kwagala. Mu kwagala temuli bizibu. Wayinza okubaawo ebisabibwa, naye tewali kwemulugunya. Tewali mulimu ogutasoboka eri okwagala.

Omutume Yokaana ayogera mu ngeri ennyangu era ey’olwatu nti: "Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa."

Buno bwe buwulize, obukulembera buli kiragiro kyonna. Kwe kwagala, nga kugonda nga tekunnalagirwa. Bakyamye nnyo, era boonoona, abo abagamba nti abantu tebalina kye bayinza kukola okuggyako okukola obutali butuukirivu, olw’embeera mwe babeera, oba olw’obuzaale, oba olw’okwegomba kw’obutonde. Okukola ebiragiro bya Katonda si kizibu. Amakubo gaabyo ga ssanyu, n’amakubo gaabyo gonna ga mirembe. Omulimu ogulindiridde obuwulize si muzibu. "Kubanga ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa."

Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu tayinza kusaba baana be ebitasoboka. Kisoboka okumusanyusa mu byonna, kubanga si muzibu kusanyusa. Si mukama mukalubo, wadde omwami omukakanyavu, "atwala ebitali bibye, era akungula by’ataasiga." Katonda yeebazibwe, kisoboka buli mwana wa Katonda okusanyusa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu! Mazima ddala kyangu nnyo okumusanyusa okusinga okusanyusa abantu. Ate era tuyinza okumanya nti tumusanyusizza. Buno bwe bujulirwa bw’Omwoyo — obukakafu obw’omunda obuva eri Katonda, obuweebwa abaana ba Katonda bonna nti bakola Kitaffe by’ayagala, era nti amakubo gaabwe gamusanyusa.

Ebiragiro bya Katonda bituukirivu era byesigamiziddwa ku bwenkanya n’amagezi. "Noolwekyo amateeka matukuvu, era n’ekiragiro kitukuvu, kiruŋŋamya era kirungi." "Amakubo go matukuvu era ga mazima, ayi ggwe Kabaka w’amawanga." N’olwekyo, ebiragiro bya Katonda bisobola okugonderwa bonna abanoonya ekisa ekibasobozesa okugonda. Ebiragiro bino biteekwa okugonderwa. Obufuzi bwa Katonda buli mu kabi. Abaana ba Katonda balina obuvunaanyizibwa okumugondera; obujeemu tebuyinza kukkirizibwa. Omwoyo gw’obujeemu gwe gwennyini omusingi gw’ekibi. Kwe kugaana obuyinza bwa Katonda, Katonda ky’atayinza kugumiikiriza. Tabangako akigumiikiriza, era okulangirira endowooza ye ku nsonga eyo kyali kitundu ku nsonga lwaki Omwana w’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo yalabisibwa mu bantu:

"Amateeka ga Musa kye gataayinza kukola, olw’okunafuyizibwa omubiri, Katonda yakikola mu Mwana we yennyini bwe yamutuma mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri ogw’ekibi, n’asalira ekibi omusango mu mubiri. Ekyo kyabaawo, eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe bwe tugondera Omwoyo, ffe abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu Mwoyo."

Omuntu yenna bw’anaayemulugunya nti abantu, mu kugwa kwabwe, banafu nnyo era tebalina buyambi okugondera ebiragiro bino ebya waggulu ebya Katonda, okuddamu okusaanidde kwe kuti: olw’okutangirira kwa Kristo, omuntu asobozesebwa okugonda. Okutangirira kye Kikolwa kya Katonda Ekisobozesa. Katonda ky’akola mu ffe, mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri era ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, kituwa ekisa ekitusobozesa, ekimala byonna ebitusabibwa, wansi w’Okutangirira. Ekisa kino kiweebwa awatali kigera, ng’okuddamu kw’okusaba. N’olwekyo, Katonda bw’alagira, mu kiseera kye kimu yeeyama okutuwa amaanyi gonna ag’okwagala n’ekisa ky’omwoyo ebyetaagisa okutuukiriza by’ayagala. Kino bwe kiri bwe kityo, omuntu talina kya kwekwasa olw’obujeemu bwe, era asaanidde nnyo okunenyezebwa olw’okugaana, oba olw’obutafuba kufuna ekisa ekyetaagisa, mw’ayinza okuweereza Mukama ng’amussaamu ekitiibwa era ng’amutya.

Waliwo ensonga enkulu abo abagamba nti tekisoboka kukwata biragiro bya Katonda gye beerabira mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo, era ye nsonga ey’amazima ag’obulamu, egamba nti olw’okusaba n’okukkiriza, obutonde bw’omuntu bukyusibwa, era n’afuulibwa omugabanira ku butonde bwa Katonda; nti aggibwamu obutayagala bwonna okugondera Katonda, era nti obutasobola bwe obw’obutonde okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda, obuva mu mbeera ye ey’okugwa n’obutaba na buyambi, buggibwawo mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa. Olw’enkyukakyuka eno ey’amaanyi ekolebwa mu butonde bwe obw’empisa, omuntu afuna amaanyi okugondera Katonda mu buli ngeri, n’okumuwa obwesigwa obujjuvu era obw’essanyu. Olwo ayinza okugamba nti, "Nsanyukira okukola ky’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange." Si bujeemu bwokka obw’omuntu ow’obutonde obuggibwawo, naye era afuna omutima ogusanyukira okugondera Ekigambo kya Katonda, nga guweereddwa mu ngeri ey’omukisa.

Bwe kigambibwa nti omuntu atannazzibwa buggya, ng’alina obunafu bwonna obw’Okugwa, tayinza kugondera Katonda, tewali agenda kukiwakanya. Naye okugamba nti omuntu bw’amala okuzzibwa obuggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’afuna obutonde obuggya, n’afuuka omwana wa Kabaka, tayinza kugondera Katonda, kwe kwekwata endowooza ey’olusaago, era kwe kulaga obutamanya obw’ennaku ku mulimu gw’Okutangirira n’ebyo bye gutegeeza.

Obuwulize obujjuvu era obutuukiridde ye mbeera omuntu w’okusaba gy’ayitirwamu. "Nga bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu, nga tebalina busungu wadde empaka," ye mbeera y’okusaba okw’obuwulize. Wano obwesigwa obw’omunda n’okwagala, awamu n’obulongoofu obw’ebweru, biteekebwa ng’ebigenda n’okusaba okukkirizibwa.

Yokaana awa ensonga lwaki okusaba kuddibwamu mu kyawandiikibwa kye twajuliza edda: "Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa."

Okuva bwe kiri nti okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda kuteekeddwa wano ng’ensonga lwaki addamu okusaba, kiba kya magezi okulowooza nti tusobola okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda, era tusobola okukola ebimusanyusa. Olowooza Katonda yandifudde okukwata ebiragiro bye obukwakkulizo bw’okusaba okukola, singa yali amanyi nti tetuyinza kukwata mateeka ge? Nedda ddala, nedda!

Obuwulize busobola okusaba n’obuvumu ku ntebe ey’ekisa, era abo abalina obuwulize be bokka abasobola okusaba mu ngeri eyo. Abantu abajeemu batya nga basemberera, era balonzalonza mu kwegayirira kwabwe. Baziyizibwa olw’ebikolwa byabwe ebibi. Omwana asaba naye omuwulize ajja mu maaso ga kitaawe n’obwesige n’obuvumu. Okumanya kwe nti muwulize kumuwa obuvumu era kumuggyamu entiisa eva mu bujeemu.

Okukola Katonda by’ayagala awatali kulonzalonza lye ssanyu era kye kirabo eky’omuntu w’okusaba atuuka ku buwanguzi. Oyo alina emikono emirongoofu n’omutima omulongoofu y’asobola okusaba n’obwesige. Mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, Yesu yagamba nti:

"Si bonna abampita nti, Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala."

Ku kigambo kino ekikulu kiyinza okwongerwako ekirala:

"Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ŋŋondera ebiragiro bya Kitange ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe."

"Omulimu gw’Omukristaayo," bw’agamba Luther, "kwe kusaba." Naye Omukristaayo alina omulimu omulala gw’ateekwa okuyiga, nga tannagenda mu maaso kuyiga byama by’omulimu gw’okusaba. Ateekwa okuyiga obulungi omulimu gw’obuwulize obutuukiridde obw’okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala. Obuwulize bugoberera okwagala, n’okusaba kugoberera obuwulize. Omulimu gw’okukwata ddala ebiragiro bya Katonda tegwawukana na mulimu gw’okusaba ddala.

Omuntu abadde omujeemu ayinza okusaba. Ayinza okusaba okusaasirwa n’okusonyiyibwa n’emirembe gy’emmeeme ye. Ayinza okujja mu maaso ga Katonda n’amaziga, ng’ayatula, n’omutima ogwenenya, era Katonda alimuwulira n’addamu okusaba kwe. Naye okusaba kw’engeri eno si kwa mwana wa Katonda, wabula kwa mwonoonyi eyeenenya, atalina kkubo ddala ly’ayinza kuyitamu okusemberera Katonda. Kwa mmeeme etannaweebwa butuukirivu, so si kwa oyo eyalokolebwa n’atabaganyizibwa ne Katonda.

Obulamu obw’obuwulize buyamba okusaba. Bwanguyiriza okusaba okutuuka ku ntebe. Katonda tayinza kulema kuwulira kusaba kw’omwana omuwulize. Bulijjo abadde awulira abaana be abawulize nga basaba. Obuwulize obutabuusabuusa bubalibwa nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda, ku ntebe ey’ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Bukola ng’amazzi g’emigga emingi egyegatta, ne buwa okusaba obungi n’okukulukuta okujjuvu awamu n’amaanyi mu kisenge eky’okusaberamu. Obulamu obw’obuwulize si bulamu obwalongoosebwako bulongoosebwa. Si bulamu obukadde obwasiigibwa langi empya, wadde obulamu obw’okugenda mu kkanisa bugenzi, wadde okwebikkako ebikolwa ebirungi kungulu. Era si kugoberera bugoberezi kungulu ebyo empisa z’abantu bonna bye zeetaaga. Ebisinga ennyo ku bino byonna bigattibwa wamu mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo omuwulize ddala, atya Katonda.

Obulamu obw’obuwulize obujjuvu; obulamu obunywerezeddwa mu nkolagana ey’okumpi ennyo ne Katonda; okwagala nga kukwatagana ddala n’okwagala kwa Katonda; obulamu obw’ebweru nga bulaga ekibala ky’obutuukirivu — obulamu obwo tebuziyiza kkubo eri ekisenge eky’okusaberamu, wabula, nga Alooni ne Kuli, buyimusa era buwanirira emikono gy’okusaba.

Bw’oba n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okusaba obulungi, oteekwa okuyiga okugonda obulungi. Bw’oba oyagala okuyiga okusaba, kale oteekwa okuba n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okuyiga okukola Katonda by’ayagala. Bw’oba oyagala okusaba Katonda, olina okusooka okuba n’okwegomba okukuyokya okumugondera. Bw’oba oyagala okutuuka eri Katonda awatali kiziyiza mu kusaba, kale buli kiziyiza eky’ekibi oba eky’obujeemu kiteekwa okuggibwawo. Katonda asanyukira okusaba kw’abaana abawulize. Okwegayirira okuva mu mimwa gy’abo abasanyukira okukola by’ayagala, kutuuka mu matu ge mangu nnyo, era kumusikiriza okukuddamu mangu era mu bungi. Amaziga gokka tegalina kye gasiimisa. Naye galina omugaso gwago mu kusaba. Amaziga gandibatizza ekifo kyaffe eky’okwegayiririramu. Oyo atakaabangako olw’ebibi bye, tabangako asabye ddala ku bibi bye. Amaziga, oluusi, ge gokka omwonoonyi eyeenenya g’ayinza okwewozesa. Naye amaziga ga byayita, ga kibi n’ebikolwa ebikyamu. Waliwo eddaala eddala eririndiridde okulinnyibwa. Lye ly’obuwulize obutabuusabuusa, era okutuusa nga lirinnyiddwa, okusaba olw’omukisa n’okuyimirizibwa okutasalako tekujja kugasa.

Wonna mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu Katonda alagibwa ng’atasiima bujeemu era ng’asalira ekibi omusango, era kino kiri bwe kityo mu bulamu bw’abalonde be nga bwe kiri mu bulamu bw’aboonoonyi. Tewali w’asiimira kibi, oba w’alekera obujeemu nga tabuvunaana. Bulijjo Katonda assa essira ku kugondera ebiragiro bye. Okubigondera kuleeta omukisa, obujeemu buleeta akabi. Kino kiri bwe kityo, mu Kigambo kya Katonda, okuva ku ntandikwa yaakyo okutuuka ku nkomerero yaakyo. Olw’ensonga eno, abasajja ab’okusaba mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu baalina obuyinza obunene bwe butyo eri Katonda. Abantu abawulize, bulijjo, be babadde ab’okumpi ennyo ne Katonda. Be bano abaasaba obulungi era ne bafuna ebintu ebinene okuva eri Katonda, era abaatuukiriza ebintu ebinene.

Okugondera Katonda kubalibwa nnyo nnyini mu kitundu ky’okusaba. Ensonga eno teyinza kuggumizibwa kusukkiridde oba emirundi egisukkiridde. Okulwanirira eddiini egumiikiriza okwonoona, kwe kusalako ettaka wansi w’ebigere by’okusaba okukola. Okwekwasa ekibi nti okugondera Katonda tekusoboka eri abantu abatazaaliddwa buggya, kwe kunyoomoola obutonde bw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, n’okuteeka abantu mu kifo okusaba okukola gye kutasoboka. Lumu Yesu yabuuza ekibuuzo ekisaanidde ddala era ekikwata ku muntu kinnoomu, ekyakuba ddala mu mutima gw’obujeemu, bwe yagamba nti: "Lwaki mumpita nti, 'Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,' so nga bye mbagamba si bye mukola?"

Oyo ayagala okusaba, ateekwa okugonda. Oyo ayagala okufuna ekintu kyonna mu kusaba kwe, ateekwa okukwatagana ddala ne Katonda. Okusaba kuteeka mu abo abasaba n’obwesimbu omwoyo gw’obuwulize, kubanga omwoyo gw’obujeemu tegwava eri Katonda era si gwa ggye lya Katonda erisaba.

Obulamu obw’obuwulize buyamba nnyo okusaba. Mazima ddala, obulamu obw’obuwulize bwetaagisa okusaba, okusaba okw’engeri etuukiriza ebintu. Obutaba na bulamu bwa buwulize bufuula okusaba omukolo ogutaliimu, erinnya obwereere. Omwonoonyi eyeenenya anoonya okusonyiyibwa n’obulokozi era afuna okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwe newaakubadde ng’obulamu bwe bujjudde amabala era bwonooneddwa ekibi. Naye abeegayiririzi ba Katonda ab’obwakabaka bajja mu maaso ge n’obulamu obw’obwakabaka. Obulamu obutukuvu buleeta okusaba okutukuvu. Abeegayiririzi ba Katonda "bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu," obubonero bw’obulamu obutuukirivu era obw’obuwulize.
fields.body_text: "Mu Fletcher ow’e Madeley mwalabikamu obuwulize bwe nandyagadde okusobola okunnyonnyola oba okukoppa. Bwamuwa omutima omwetegefu okwaniriza buli musaalaba mangu era n’essanyu. Yalina okwagala okw’enjawulo eri abaana b’endiga ab’ekisibo, era yafubanga nnyo okubayigiriza, ekyo kye yalinamu ekirabo eky’enjawulo. . . . Byonna bye yakolanga nange byali bitabuddwamu nnyo okusaba n’okutendereza, ne kiba nti buli mulimu, na buli kijjulo, byali ng’ebiwunyiddwako akaloosa kaabyo." — JOHN WESLEY. MU MATEEKA ga Musa, obuwulize bwatwalibwanga nga "Okugonda kusinga ssaddaaka, era n’okuwuliriza kusinga amasavu g’endiga ennume." Mu kitabo ky’Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 5:29, Musa alaga Katonda Ayinzabyonna ng’ayogera ku mpisa eno yennyini mu ngeri etaleka kubuusabuusa kwonna ku bukulu bw’agiteekako. Ng’ayogera ku bukyamu bw’abantu be, akaaba nti: "Singa nno bulijjo emitima gyabwe gibeera bwe gityo; ne bantya, era ne bagonderanga amateeka gange gonna, ne balyoka balaba ebirungi awamu n’abaana baabwe emirembe gyonna!" Tewali kubuusabuusa nti obuwulize mpisa ya waggulu, mpisa ya muserikale. Okugonda kwa muserikale okusinga byonna. Lye ssomo lye ery’olubereberye n’ery’enkomerero, era alina okuyiga okukugoberera buli kiseera, awatali kwebuuza, era awatali kwemulugunya. Ate era obuwulize kwe kukkiriza nga kukola, era bwe bukulukuta okuva mu kwagala, nga bwe bugezesa okwagala ddala. "Oyo alina ebiragiro byange n’abikwata, oyo y’anjagala." Ekirala: obuwulize bwe bukuuma okwagala era bwe bulamu bwakwo. "Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange," Yesu bw’agamba, "olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ŋŋondera ebiragiro bya Kitange ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe." Nga kino kigambo kya kitalo ekiraga enkolagana obuwulize gye buleeta era gye bukuuma! Omwana wa Katonda akuumibwa mu kifuba ky’okwagala kwa Kitaffe, olw’obuwulize bwe! Era ekisobozesa Omwana wa Katonda okubeera bulijjo mu kwagala kwa Kitaawe kibikkulwa mu kigambo kye yennyini: "Kubanga bulijjo nkola by’ayagala." Ekirabo ky’Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kigera ekijjuvu era mu bumanyirivu obusingawo obugagga, kyesigamye ku buwulize obw’okwagala: "Obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange," kye kigambo kya Mukama waffe. "Nange ndisaba Kitange n’abawa Omubeezi omulala anaabeeranga nammwe emirembe n’emirembe." Okugondera Katonda kye kikakaso ky’okukulaakulana mu mwoyo, okumatira munda, n’obunywevu bw’omutima. "Bwe munaagondanga ne muwulira, munaalyanga ebirungi eby’ensi." Obuwulize buggulawo emiryango gy’Ekibuga Ekitukuvu, era buwa ekkubo eri omuti ogw’obulamu. "Balina omukisa abo abakola ebiragiro bye, balyoke babe n’obuyinza ku muti ogw’obulamu, era bayingire mu kibuga nga bayita mu miryango." Obuwulize kye ki? Kwe kukola Katonda by’ayagala: kwe kukwata ebiragiro bye. Biragiro bimeka ebiteekwa okukwatibwa obuwulize okuba obwannamaddala? Okukwata ekitundu kyabyo, n’okumenya ekitundu ekirala — obwo bwe buwulize obwannamaddala? Okukwata ebiragiro byonna okuggyako kimu — obwo bwe buwulize? Ku nsonga eno, Yakobo Omutume ayogera lwatu ddala: "Omuntu akwata amateeka gonna," bw’agamba, "naye n’asobyako erimu, omusango gumusinga mu ngeri y’emu ng’oli asobezza amateeka gonna." Omwoyo ogusindiikiriza omuntu okumenya ekiragiro kimu gwe gumu oguyinza okumusindiikiriza okubimenya byonna. Ebiragiro bya Katonda kintu kimu, era okumenya ekimu kiba kulumba nnono eri wansi wa byonna era ebuna mu byonna. Oyo atalonzalonza kumenya kiragiro kimu — kino kirabika nnyo — bw’anaanyigirizibwa mu ngeri y’emu, era ng’ali mu mbeera ze zimu, yandibimenye byonna. Okugonda mu byonna kwe kusabibwa abantu bonna. Tewali kirala kitali buwulize obujjuvu obutabuusabuusa ekiyinza okumatiza Katonda, era okukwata ebiragiro bye byonna kye kikakasa obuwulize obwo Katonda bw’ayagala. Naye tuyinza okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda byonna? Omuntu ayinza okufuna obusobozi obw’empisa obumusobozesa okugondera buli kimu ku byo? Ddala ayinza. Mu buli ngeri, omuntu ayinza, ng’ayita mu kusaba, okufuna obusobozi okukola ekyo kyennyini. Katonda awa ebiragiro abantu bye batayinza kugondera? Ye mukakanyavu, akola nga bw’ayagala, muzibu, era atalina kwagala, n’okuwa ebiragiro ebitayinza kugonderwa? Okuddamu kwe kuti: mu byafaayo byonna eby’Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, tewali na kimu ekiwandiikiddwa nga Katonda yalagira omuntu yenna okukola ekintu ekyali kisukka amaanyi ge. Katonda mukyamu era talowooza ku bantu, n’okusaba omuntu ekyo ky’atasobola kuwa? Nedda ddala. Okulowooza bwe kityo kwe kuwaayiriza empisa ya Katonda. Ka tulowooze ku kirowoozo kino akaseera katono: Abazadde ab’oku nsi basaba abaana baabwe okukola emirimu gye batayinza kukola? Taata ki ayinza n’okulowooza okuba omukyamu bw’atyo, era omunyigiriza bw’atyo? Katonda talina kisa n’obwenkanya okusinga abazadde ab’oku nsi abalina ebisobyo? Bo basinga obulungi n’obwenkanya Katonda atuukiridde? Nga kirowoozo kya busirusiru nnyo era ekitayinza kuyimirirawo! Mu nnono, okugondera Katonda mpisa y’emu n’okugondera abazadde ab’oku nsi. Okutwalira awamu, kitegeeza okuleka ekkubo lyo, n’ogoberera ery’omulala; okuwaayo okwagala kwo eri okwagala kw’omulala; okwewaayo wansi w’obuyinza n’ebyo omuzadde by’ayagala. Ebiragiro, oba biva eri Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu oba eri kitaffe ow’oku nsi, bikulemberwa okwagala, era ebiragiro ng’ebyo byonna bigendererwamu obulungi bw’abo abalagirwa. Ebiragiro bya Katonda tebiweebwa mu bukambwe wadde mu kunyigiriza. Bulijjo biweebwa mu kwagala era ku lw’obulungi bwaffe, noolwekyo kitusaanira okubiwuliriza n’okubigondera. Mu bigambo ebirala, era nga tukipimira ku muwendo gwakyo ogusinga obutono — Katonda bw’aba nga yatuwa ebiragiro bye okutuleetera ebirungi, noolwekyo kitugasa okuba abawulize. Obuwulize buleeta empeera yaabwo. Katonda bw’atyo bwe yakiteekawo, era okuva bwe yakikola, n’amagezi g’omuntu gasobola okutegeera nti teyandisabye ekyo kye tutayinza kuwa. Obuwulize kwe kwagala okutuukiriza buli kiragiro, kwe kwagala nga kweyoleka. N’olwekyo, obuwulize si kintu kizibu ekitusabibwa, okusinga obuweereza omusajja bw’awa mukazi we, oba omukazi bw’awa bba. Okwagala kusanyukira okugonda n’okusanyusa gwe kwagala. Mu kwagala temuli bizibu. Wayinza okubaawo ebisabibwa, naye tewali kwemulugunya. Tewali mulimu ogutasoboka eri okwagala. Omutume Yokaana ayogera mu ngeri ennyangu era ey’olwatu nti: "Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa." Buno bwe buwulize, obukulembera buli kiragiro kyonna. Kwe kwagala, nga kugonda nga tekunnalagirwa. Bakyamye nnyo, era boonoona, abo abagamba nti abantu tebalina kye bayinza kukola okuggyako okukola obutali butuukirivu, olw’embeera mwe babeera, oba olw’obuzaale, oba olw’okwegomba kw’obutonde. Okukola ebiragiro bya Katonda si kizibu. Amakubo gaabyo ga ssanyu, n’amakubo gaabyo gonna ga mirembe. Omulimu ogulindiridde obuwulize si muzibu. "Kubanga ekikoligo kyange kyangu, n’omugugu gwange teguzitowa." Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu tayinza kusaba baana be ebitasoboka. Kisoboka okumusanyusa mu byonna, kubanga si muzibu kusanyusa. Si mukama mukalubo, wadde omwami omukakanyavu, "atwala ebitali bibye, era akungula by’ataasiga." Katonda yeebazibwe, kisoboka buli mwana wa Katonda okusanyusa Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu! Mazima ddala kyangu nnyo okumusanyusa okusinga okusanyusa abantu. Ate era tuyinza okumanya nti tumusanyusizza. Buno bwe bujulirwa bw’Omwoyo — obukakafu obw’omunda obuva eri Katonda, obuweebwa abaana ba Katonda bonna nti bakola Kitaffe by’ayagala, era nti amakubo gaabwe gamusanyusa. Ebiragiro bya Katonda bituukirivu era byesigamiziddwa ku bwenkanya n’amagezi. "Noolwekyo amateeka matukuvu, era n’ekiragiro kitukuvu, kiruŋŋamya era kirungi." "Amakubo go matukuvu era ga mazima, ayi ggwe Kabaka w’amawanga." N’olwekyo, ebiragiro bya Katonda bisobola okugonderwa bonna abanoonya ekisa ekibasobozesa okugonda. Ebiragiro bino biteekwa okugonderwa. Obufuzi bwa Katonda buli mu kabi. Abaana ba Katonda balina obuvunaanyizibwa okumugondera; obujeemu tebuyinza kukkirizibwa. Omwoyo gw’obujeemu gwe gwennyini omusingi gw’ekibi. Kwe kugaana obuyinza bwa Katonda, Katonda ky’atayinza kugumiikiriza. Tabangako akigumiikiriza, era okulangirira endowooza ye ku nsonga eyo kyali kitundu ku nsonga lwaki Omwana w’Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo yalabisibwa mu bantu: "Amateeka ga Musa kye gataayinza kukola, olw’okunafuyizibwa omubiri, Katonda yakikola mu Mwana we yennyini bwe yamutuma mu kifaananyi ky’omubiri ogw’ekibi, n’asalira ekibi omusango mu mubiri. Ekyo kyabaawo, eby’obutuukirivu mu mateeka biryoke bituukirire mu ffe bwe tugondera Omwoyo, ffe abatatambulira mu mubiri naye abatambulira mu Mwoyo." Omuntu yenna bw’anaayemulugunya nti abantu, mu kugwa kwabwe, banafu nnyo era tebalina buyambi okugondera ebiragiro bino ebya waggulu ebya Katonda, okuddamu okusaanidde kwe kuti: olw’okutangirira kwa Kristo, omuntu asobozesebwa okugonda. Okutangirira kye Kikolwa kya Katonda Ekisobozesa. Katonda ky’akola mu ffe, mu kuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri era ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu, kituwa ekisa ekitusobozesa, ekimala byonna ebitusabibwa, wansi w’Okutangirira. Ekisa kino kiweebwa awatali kigera, ng’okuddamu kw’okusaba. N’olwekyo, Katonda bw’alagira, mu kiseera kye kimu yeeyama okutuwa amaanyi gonna ag’okwagala n’ekisa ky’omwoyo ebyetaagisa okutuukiriza by’ayagala. Kino bwe kiri bwe kityo, omuntu talina kya kwekwasa olw’obujeemu bwe, era asaanidde nnyo okunenyezebwa olw’okugaana, oba olw’obutafuba kufuna ekisa ekyetaagisa, mw’ayinza okuweereza Mukama ng’amussaamu ekitiibwa era ng’amutya. Waliwo ensonga enkulu abo abagamba nti tekisoboka kukwata biragiro bya Katonda gye beerabira mu ngeri ey’ekyewuunyo, era ye nsonga ey’amazima ag’obulamu, egamba nti olw’okusaba n’okukkiriza, obutonde bw’omuntu bukyusibwa, era n’afuulibwa omugabanira ku butonde bwa Katonda; nti aggibwamu obutayagala bwonna okugondera Katonda, era nti obutasobola bwe obw’obutonde okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda, obuva mu mbeera ye ey’okugwa n’obutaba na buyambi, buggibwawo mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa. Olw’enkyukakyuka eno ey’amaanyi ekolebwa mu butonde bwe obw’empisa, omuntu afuna amaanyi okugondera Katonda mu buli ngeri, n’okumuwa obwesigwa obujjuvu era obw’essanyu. Olwo ayinza okugamba nti, "Nsanyukira okukola ky’oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange." Si bujeemu bwokka obw’omuntu ow’obutonde obuggibwawo, naye era afuna omutima ogusanyukira okugondera Ekigambo kya Katonda, nga guweereddwa mu ngeri ey’omukisa. Bwe kigambibwa nti omuntu atannazzibwa buggya, ng’alina obunafu bwonna obw’Okugwa, tayinza kugondera Katonda, tewali agenda kukiwakanya. Naye okugamba nti omuntu bw’amala okuzzibwa obuggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’afuna obutonde obuggya, n’afuuka omwana wa Kabaka, tayinza kugondera Katonda, kwe kwekwata endowooza ey’olusaago, era kwe kulaga obutamanya obw’ennaku ku mulimu gw’Okutangirira n’ebyo bye gutegeeza. Obuwulize obujjuvu era obutuukiridde ye mbeera omuntu w’okusaba gy’ayitirwamu. "Nga bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu, nga tebalina busungu wadde empaka," ye mbeera y’okusaba okw’obuwulize. Wano obwesigwa obw’omunda n’okwagala, awamu n’obulongoofu obw’ebweru, biteekebwa ng’ebigenda n’okusaba okukkirizibwa. Yokaana awa ensonga lwaki okusaba kuddibwamu mu kyawandiikibwa kye twajuliza edda: "Era buli kye tumusaba akituwa, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye, era ne tukola ebimusanyusa." Okuva bwe kiri nti okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda kuteekeddwa wano ng’ensonga lwaki addamu okusaba, kiba kya magezi okulowooza nti tusobola okukwata ebiragiro bya Katonda, era tusobola okukola ebimusanyusa. Olowooza Katonda yandifudde okukwata ebiragiro bye obukwakkulizo bw’okusaba okukola, singa yali amanyi nti tetuyinza kukwata mateeka ge? Nedda ddala, nedda! Obuwulize busobola okusaba n’obuvumu ku ntebe ey’ekisa, era abo abalina obuwulize be bokka abasobola okusaba mu ngeri eyo. Abantu abajeemu batya nga basemberera, era balonzalonza mu kwegayirira kwabwe. Baziyizibwa olw’ebikolwa byabwe ebibi. Omwana asaba naye omuwulize ajja mu maaso ga kitaawe n’obwesige n’obuvumu. Okumanya kwe nti muwulize kumuwa obuvumu era kumuggyamu entiisa eva mu bujeemu. Okukola Katonda by’ayagala awatali kulonzalonza lye ssanyu era kye kirabo eky’omuntu w’okusaba atuuka ku buwanguzi. Oyo alina emikono emirongoofu n’omutima omulongoofu y’asobola okusaba n’obwesige. Mu Kubuulira ku Lusozi, Yesu yagamba nti: "Si bonna abampita nti, Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala." Ku kigambo kino ekikulu kiyinza okwongerwako ekirala: "Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ŋŋondera ebiragiro bya Kitange ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe." "Omulimu gw’Omukristaayo," bw’agamba Luther, "kwe kusaba." Naye Omukristaayo alina omulimu omulala gw’ateekwa okuyiga, nga tannagenda mu maaso kuyiga byama by’omulimu gw’okusaba. Ateekwa okuyiga obulungi omulimu gw’obuwulize obutuukiridde obw’okukola Kitaffe by’ayagala. Obuwulize bugoberera okwagala, n’okusaba kugoberera obuwulize. Omulimu gw’okukwata ddala ebiragiro bya Katonda tegwawukana na mulimu gw’okusaba ddala. Omuntu abadde omujeemu ayinza okusaba. Ayinza okusaba okusaasirwa n’okusonyiyibwa n’emirembe gy’emmeeme ye. Ayinza okujja mu maaso ga Katonda n’amaziga, ng’ayatula, n’omutima ogwenenya, era Katonda alimuwulira n’addamu okusaba kwe. Naye okusaba kw’engeri eno si kwa mwana wa Katonda, wabula kwa mwonoonyi eyeenenya, atalina kkubo ddala ly’ayinza kuyitamu okusemberera Katonda. Kwa mmeeme etannaweebwa butuukirivu, so si kwa oyo eyalokolebwa n’atabaganyizibwa ne Katonda. Obulamu obw’obuwulize buyamba okusaba. Bwanguyiriza okusaba okutuuka ku ntebe. Katonda tayinza kulema kuwulira kusaba kw’omwana omuwulize. Bulijjo abadde awulira abaana be abawulize nga basaba. Obuwulize obutabuusabuusa bubalibwa nnyo mu maaso ga Katonda, ku ntebe ey’ekisa eky’omu ggulu. Bukola ng’amazzi g’emigga emingi egyegatta, ne buwa okusaba obungi n’okukulukuta okujjuvu awamu n’amaanyi mu kisenge eky’okusaberamu. Obulamu obw’obuwulize si bulamu obwalongoosebwako bulongoosebwa. Si bulamu obukadde obwasiigibwa langi empya, wadde obulamu obw’okugenda mu kkanisa bugenzi, wadde okwebikkako ebikolwa ebirungi kungulu. Era si kugoberera bugoberezi kungulu ebyo empisa z’abantu bonna bye zeetaaga. Ebisinga ennyo ku bino byonna bigattibwa wamu mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo omuwulize ddala, atya Katonda. Obulamu obw’obuwulize obujjuvu; obulamu obunywerezeddwa mu nkolagana ey’okumpi ennyo ne Katonda; okwagala nga kukwatagana ddala n’okwagala kwa Katonda; obulamu obw’ebweru nga bulaga ekibala ky’obutuukirivu — obulamu obwo tebuziyiza kkubo eri ekisenge eky’okusaberamu, wabula, nga Alooni ne Kuli, buyimusa era buwanirira emikono gy’okusaba. Bw’oba n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okusaba obulungi, oteekwa okuyiga okugonda obulungi. Bw’oba oyagala okuyiga okusaba, kale oteekwa okuba n’okwegomba okw’amaanyi okuyiga okukola Katonda by’ayagala. Bw’oba oyagala okusaba Katonda, olina okusooka okuba n’okwegomba okukuyokya okumugondera. Bw’oba oyagala okutuuka eri Katonda awatali kiziyiza mu kusaba, kale buli kiziyiza eky’ekibi oba eky’obujeemu kiteekwa okuggibwawo. Katonda asanyukira okusaba kw’abaana abawulize. Okwegayirira okuva mu mimwa gy’abo abasanyukira okukola by’ayagala, kutuuka mu matu ge mangu nnyo, era kumusikiriza okukuddamu mangu era mu bungi. Amaziga gokka tegalina kye gasiimisa. Naye galina omugaso gwago mu kusaba. Amaziga gandibatizza ekifo kyaffe eky’okwegayiririramu. Oyo atakaabangako olw’ebibi bye, tabangako asabye ddala ku bibi bye. Amaziga, oluusi, ge gokka omwonoonyi eyeenenya g’ayinza okwewozesa. Naye amaziga ga byayita, ga kibi n’ebikolwa ebikyamu. Waliwo eddaala eddala eririndiridde okulinnyibwa. Lye ly’obuwulize obutabuusabuusa, era okutuusa nga lirinnyiddwa, okusaba olw’omukisa n’okuyimirizibwa okutasalako tekujja kugasa. Wonna mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu Katonda alagibwa ng’atasiima bujeemu era ng’asalira ekibi omusango, era kino kiri bwe kityo mu bulamu bw’abalonde be nga bwe kiri mu bulamu bw’aboonoonyi. Tewali w’asiimira kibi, oba w’alekera obujeemu nga tabuvunaana. Bulijjo Katonda assa essira ku kugondera ebiragiro bye. Okubigondera kuleeta omukisa, obujeemu buleeta akabi. Kino kiri bwe kityo, mu Kigambo kya Katonda, okuva ku ntandikwa yaakyo okutuuka ku nkomerero yaakyo. Olw’ensonga eno, abasajja ab’okusaba mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu baalina obuyinza obunene bwe butyo eri Katonda. Abantu abawulize, bulijjo, be babadde ab’okumpi ennyo ne Katonda. Be bano abaasaba obulungi era ne bafuna ebintu ebinene okuva eri Katonda, era abaatuukiriza ebintu ebinene. Okugondera Katonda kubalibwa nnyo nnyini mu kitundu ky’okusaba. Ensonga eno teyinza kuggumizibwa kusukkiridde oba emirundi egisukkiridde. Okulwanirira eddiini egumiikiriza okwonoona, kwe kusalako ettaka wansi w’ebigere by’okusaba okukola. Okwekwasa ekibi nti okugondera Katonda tekusoboka eri abantu abatazaaliddwa buggya, kwe kunyoomoola obutonde bw’okuzaalibwa omulundi ogw’okubiri, n’okuteeka abantu mu kifo okusaba okukola gye kutasoboka. Lumu Yesu yabuuza ekibuuzo ekisaanidde ddala era ekikwata ku muntu kinnoomu, ekyakuba ddala mu mutima gw’obujeemu, bwe yagamba nti: "Lwaki mumpita nti, 'Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe,' so nga bye mbagamba si bye mukola?" Oyo ayagala okusaba, ateekwa okugonda. Oyo ayagala okufuna ekintu kyonna mu kusaba kwe, ateekwa okukwatagana ddala ne Katonda. Okusaba kuteeka mu abo abasaba n’obwesimbu omwoyo gw’obuwulize, kubanga omwoyo gw’obujeemu tegwava eri Katonda era si gwa ggye lya Katonda erisaba. Obulamu obw’obuwulize buyamba nnyo okusaba. Mazima ddala, obulamu obw’obuwulize bwetaagisa okusaba, okusaba okw’engeri etuukiriza ebintu. Obutaba na bulamu bwa buwulize bufuula okusaba omukolo ogutaliimu, erinnya obwereere. Omwonoonyi eyeenenya anoonya okusonyiyibwa n’obulokozi era afuna okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwe newaakubadde ng’obulamu bwe bujjudde amabala era bwonooneddwa ekibi. Naye abeegayiririzi ba Katonda ab’obwakabaka bajja mu maaso ge n’obulamu obw’obwakabaka. Obulamu obutukuvu buleeta okusaba okutukuvu. Abeegayiririzi ba Katonda "bayimusa emikono gyabwe emirongoofu," obubonero bw’obulamu obutuukirivu era obw’obuwulize.

fields.title: Okusaba n’Obuwulize (Kweyongerayo)
fields.body_html:
"Mu myaka gyange ekinaana, mmanyi abantu bangi ab’ekyokulabirako, abatukuvu mu mutima ne mu bulamu. Naye omu eyenkana John Fletcher — omuwulize era eyeewaayo eri Katonda munda ne kungulu bw’atyo — simumanyangako." — JOHN WESLEY.

KISAANIDDE okumanya nti okusaba okuweebwa ekifo ekyo ekya waggulu ennyo, era okuvaamu ebibala ebinene, si kwogera bwogezi bigambo bya ssaala, wabula kusaba kutukuvu. Kwe "okusaba kw’abatukuvu," okusaba kw’abantu ba Katonda abatukuvu. Emabega w’okusaba okw’engeri eyo, nga kukuwa amaanyi n’omuliro, waliwo abasajja n’abakazi abeewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda, abeeyawudde ddala ku kibi, era abaayawulibwa mu bujjuvu eri Katonda. Bano be bulijjo abawa okusaba amaanyi, obuzito n’obuyinza.

Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo yasinga bonna mu kusaba, kubanga yasinga bonna mu butukuvu. Okwewaayo ddala eri Katonda, okwewaayo okujjuvu, okutwala omuntu yenna, mu muliro ogw’okwewaayo okutukuvu — bino byonna biwa okukkiriza ebiwaawaatiro n’okusaba amaanyi. Biggulawo oluggi olw’entebe ey’ekisa, era bireeta amaanyi amangi eri Katonda Ayinzabyonna.

"Okuyimusa emikono emirongoofu" kwetaagisa nnyo mu kusaba okufaanana okwa Kristo. Naye si butukuvu obuwaayo eri Katonda ekisenge kyokka, obwawula essaawa emu yokka ku lulwe, wabula okwewaayo okukwata omuntu yenna, okuwaayo obulamu bwonna eri Katonda.

Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, "omutukuvu, ataliiko musango, wadde ebbala, eyayawulibwa okuva ku abo abalina ebibi," yalina eddembe ejjuvu okusemberera, n’ekkubo eggule eri Katonda mu kusaba. Era yalina ekkubo lino eddembe era ejjuvu olw’obuwulize bwe obutabuusabuusa eri Kitaawe. Mu bulamu bwe bwonna ku nsi, ekyamweraliikirizanga era kye yasinganga okwegomba kwali kukola Kitaawe by’ayagala. Era kino, nga kyegatta ku kirala — okumanya nti yali ategese obulamu bwe bw’atyo — kyamuwa obwesige n’obukakafu, ebyamusobozesa okusemberera entebe ey’ekisa n’obwesige obutaliiko kkomo, obuva mu buwulize, era obusuubiza okukkirizibwa, okuwulirwa, n’okuddibwamu.

Obuwulize obw’okwagala bututeeka mu kifo we tuyinza "okusaba ekintu kyonna mu linnya lye," nga tulina obukakafu nti "alikikola." Obuwulize obw’okwagala butuyingiza mu kitundu ky’okusaba, era butufuula abasikira b’obugagga bwa Kristo, n’obugagga bw’ekisa kye, olw’okujja kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu anaabeeranga naffe, era anaabeeranga mu ffe. Okugondera Katonda n’essanyu kutusaanyiza okusaba okukola.

Obuwulize buno obutatusaanyiza kyokka naye obukulembera n’okusaba, buteekwa okuba obw’okwagala, obutasalako, nga bulijjo bukola Kitaffe by’ayagala, era nga bugoberera n’essanyu ekkubo ly’ebiragiro bya Katonda.

Ku Kabaka Keezeekiya, kwali kwegayirira kwa maanyi okwakyusa ekiragiro kya Katonda nti agenda kufa so si kuba mulamu. Kabaka oyo eyali mulwadde yasaba Katonda ajjukire engeri gye yatambuliranga mu maaso ge n’amazima n’omutima ogutuukiridde. Eri Katonda, kino kyabalibwa. Yawulira okwegayirira kwe, era ekyavaamu, okufa ne kuziyizibwa okutuuka ku Keezeekiya okumala emyaka kkumi n’etaano.

Yesu yayiga obuwulize mu ssomero ly’okubonaabona, era mu kiseera kye kimu, yayiga okusaba mu ssomero ly’obuwulize. Nga bwe kiri nti okusaba kw’omuntu omutuukirivu kwe kubeera n’obuyinza bungi, bwe kityo n’obutuukirivu bwe buwulize eri Katonda. Omuntu omutuukirivu muntu muwulize, era y’oyo ayinza okusaba okukola, ayinza okutuukiriza ebintu ebinene bw’afukamira.

Okusaba okwa nnamaddala, kijjukirwe, si kuwulira kwokka, wadde ebitontome, wadde okwogera obulungi. Era tekuli mu kwogera mu ddoboozi eddungi nti, "Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe." Okusaba si bigambo bugambo; si kukoowoola bukoowoozi Linnya. Okusaba bwe buwulize. Kuzimbiddwa ku lwazi olutamenyeka olw’okugondera Katonda. Abo bokka abagonda be balina eddembe okusaba. Emabega w’okusaba walina okubaawo okukola; era okukola Katonda by’ayagala buli lunaku mu bulamu kwe kuwa okusaba amaanyi gaakwo, nga Mukama waffe bwe yayigiriza lwatu:

"Si bonna abampita nti, Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, be baliyingira obwakabaka obw’omu ggulu, wabula abo bokka abakola ebyo Kitange ali mu ggulu by’ayagala. Ku lunaku luli bangi baliŋŋamba nti, Mukama waffe, Mukama waffe, twayogeranga eby’obunnabbi mu linnya lyo, era ne tugoba ne baddayimooni mu linnya lyo, ne tukola n’ebyamagero bingi mu linnya lyo. Ndibaddamu nti, Sibamanyi, muve mu maaso gange, kubanga ebikolwa byammwe byali bibi."

Tewali linnya, ne bwe liba ery’omuwendo n’amaanyi bwe lityo, eriyinza okukuuma n’okuwa amaanyi okusaba okutagenda wamu na kukola Katonda by’ayagala. Era n’okukola, awatali kusaba, tekuyinza kukuuma muntu kunenyezebwa Katonda. Singa Katonda by’ayagala tebifuga bulamu, okusaba tekujja kuba kintu kirala wabula okuwulira okw’obunafu. Singa okusaba tekutuzzaamu maanyi, tekutukuza era tekuluŋŋamya mulimu gwaffe, olwo okwagala kwaffe ffekka kuyingira, ne kwonoona omulimu n’omukozi.

Nga nnyingi era nkulu ebirowoozo ebikyamu ku bitundu ebyannamaddala n’enkola y’okusaba! Waliwo bangi abeegomba ennyo okufuna okuddibwamu kw’okusaba kwabwe naye ne batafuna mpeera wadde omukisa. Bassa ebirowoozo byabwe ku kisuubizo kya Katonda ekimu, olwo ne bafuba, nga bagumiikiriza mu bukakanyavu, okufuna okukkiriza okumala okukikwata n’okukyefunira. Okussa ebirowoozo ku kisuubizo ekimu ekikulu kuyinza okuyamba mu kunyweza okukkiriza, naye ku kukwata kuno ku kisuubizo kuteekwa okugattibwako okusaba okunyiikivu era okutakoowa okusuubira, era okulindirira okutuusa okukkiriza lwe kukula ennyo. Era ani asobola era asaanidde okusaba bwe kutyo, okuggyako omuntu, mangu, n’essanyu era bulijjo, agondera Katonda?

Okukkiriza, mu ngeri yaakwo esinga obukulu, y’embeera era kye kikolwa eky’emmeeme eyeewaddeyo eri Katonda, Ekigambo kye n’Omwoyo we mwe bibeera. Kituufu nti okukkiriza kuteekwa okubaawo mu ngeri emu oba endala okusindiikiriza okusaba; naye mu ngeri yaakwo esinga amaanyi, era mu bibala byakwo ebisinga obunene, okukkiriza kye kibala ky’okusaba. Nti okukkiriza kwongera obusobozi n’obukozi bw’okusaba, kituufu; naye era kituufu nti okusaba kwongera obusobozi n’obukozi bw’okukkiriza. Okusaba n’okukkiriza bikola, bikolagana, era bikwatagana, nga buli kimu kikola ku kinnaakyo.

Okugondera Katonda kuyamba okukkiriza nga tewali mpisa ndala eyinza kukikola. Obuwulize bwe bubaawo — okukkiriza okutabuusabuusa amaanyi n’obukulu bw’ebiragiro bya Katonda — okukkiriza kulekera awo okuba omulimu kumpi ogusukkiridde amaanyi g’omuntu. Tekwetaagisa kufuba nnyo okukukozesa. Okugondera Katonda kwanguya okukkiriza n’okwesiga Katonda. Omwoyo gw’obuwulize bwe gujjula ddala mu mmeeme; okwagala bwe kuba nga kwewaddeyo ddala eri Katonda; bwe wabaawo ekigendererwa ekinywevu, ekitakyuka, okugondera Katonda, okukkiriza kumpi kwekkiririza kwokka. Okukkiriza olwo kufuuka kumpi ekintu ekyekola kyokka. Oluvannyuma lw’obuwulize, kye kiddako mu butonde, era kikolebwa mangu era nga kyangu. Obuzibu mu kusaba tebuli mu kukkiriza, wabula mu buwulize, bwe musingi gw’okukkiriza.

Tuteekwa okwekenneenya obulungi obuwulize bwaffe, ensulo ez’ekyama ez’ebikolwa byaffe, obwesigwa bw’omutima gwaffe eri Katonda, bwe tuba twagala okusaba obulungi, era nga twegomba okufuna ebisingawo mu kusaba kwaffe. Obuwulize gwe musingi gw’okusaba okukola; bwe buno, obutusembeza okumpi ne Katonda.

Obutaba na buwulize mu bulamu bwaffe bumenya okusaba kwaffe. Emirundi mingi, obulamu buba mu bujeemu era kino kituteeka mu kifo okusaba we kuba kumpi okutasoboka, okuggyako okusaba okusaasirwa n’okusonyiyibwa. Obulamu obw’obujeemu buleeta okusaba okubi ennyo ddala. Obujeemu buggalawo oluggi lw’ekisenge eky’omunda, era buziyiza ekkubo erigenda mu Kifo Ekitukuvu Ennyo. Tewali muntu ayinza kusaba — okusaba ddala — atagonda.

Okwagala kuteekwa okuweebwayo eri Katonda ng’obukwakkulizo obusooka obw’okusaba kwonna okutuuka ku buwanguzi. Buli kimu ku ffe kiggya langi yaakyo mu mpisa yaffe ey’omunda ennyo. Okwagala okw’ekyama kwe kuzimba empisa era kwe kufuga enneeyisa. N’olwekyo, okwagala kukola omulimu omukulu mu kusaba kwonna okutuuka ku buwanguzi. Tewayinza kubaawo kusaba mu makulu gaakwo agasinga obugagga n’amazima, okwagala we kutaweereddwayo ddala era mu bujjuvu eri Katonda. Obwesigwa buno obutakyukakyuka eri Katonda bwe bukwakkulizo obwetaagisa ennyo ddala eri okusaba okusinga obulungi, okusinga amazima, okusinga okukola. Kale "tuteekwa bweteekwa okwesiga n’okugonda; tewali kkubo ddala ddala, ery’okusanyukira mu Yesu — wabula okwesiga, n’okugonda!"
